notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.9
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.9. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Captains!

Our 10th Anniversary update is finally here, but our development team are also already steaming ahead with more new content to come in Update 14.9. It's time for a sneak peek!

Here's a quick breakdown of some of the most notable new content coming in 14.9:

Liberty Harbor: In honor of the 250th birthday of the U.S. Navy, we invite you to build your own Naval Base—Liberty Harbor. Each structure serves a specific purpose, so choose your build order carefully. Complete combat missions, and once the whole base is finished, you can claim new U.S. cruiser Bridgeport for free, in addition to Commander David Farragut for assembling a dedicated collection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b3fcb30842b20c91e19d9128331dbdf710814f0b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ad9c31eae42f3bafdac95ac4a7d6da0b40ed0563.jpg
Dockyard: Lüshun B: We're starting Black Friday early this year! You'll soon be able to build the black version of Pan-Asian destroyer Lüshun—a ship that first graced the Dockyard in the form of her standard version in Update 12.7. Complete 35 shipbuilding phases—30 of which can be finished via combat missions—to unlock this rapid-firing, deepwater torpedo-launching machine!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b815c9d816f2bf32fe7e1b4849d7ca8c612d88bc.jpg

German Reunification Event Pass: Our Event Pass this update is dedicated to the reunification of East and West Germany, a historical event that's celebrated every year in October. The first progression line will net you, among others, statuesque Commander Goldelse. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4ca024ab2f163e816334dad407dbb4d03c5283bb.png

The second progression line offers rewards such as the Infernal permanent camouflage for Tier VIII and X ships, and Commander Delphius Ora-cle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/78031a7a41f541f215020ba9195a1aef043693ca.png


If you want the full, detailed breakdown on these features and more, check out our dedicated article on our website! Click through to it right here:

EU NA ASIA

notes.title: Update 14.8 | A Decade at Sea, New German Cruisers, and Anniversary Celebrations
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a4ac12ceb46233b6fadd46b3ec00aa506089ee46.jpg

[previewyoutube=h4vpGT6nS9Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.8. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

EU NA ASIA

A Decade at Sea
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a60e4e0bbc60f19779cd2e9f04be1a4643fce841.jpg

Celebrate World of Warships' 10th Anniversary with an event packed with rewards!


Battle Performance Bonuses return, giving you the chance to earn Festive Tokens or Steel (for superships).
Festive Tokens can be exchanged for new Japanese Tier X cruiser Kushiro, bonus packages for Tier X ships, Supercontainers, the "This Is Fine" enemy destruction effect, and containers from historic collections that unlock unique Commanders.
Log in during Update 14.8 for a guaranteed Tenth Anniversary Gift container, which drops a Tier VI Premium ship.
Updated Honorable Service: Players with 5 years in the game receive a Premium Ship VIII Elite container, and those with 10 years receive a Special Ship X Elite container (minimum 25 battles required).
Exclusive thank-you rewards for Alpha and Beta Testers.


Decade Dock Port & Update Navigator
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fe8e55a40aee3d4dc7ab14ecc9fb8e7b03ccbb21.jpg

Jump into the anniversary celebrations!


Explore the interactive Decade Dock Port, offering tons of Easter eggs and a 10-year commemorative journal.
The brand-new Update Navigator feature provides a digest of current update content.
Your Battle Record appears in the Navigator, showing personalized stats like battles played, most-used ships, and combat performance, with a shareable link.
Available until Update 14.11.


The Grand Voyage Continues
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6ec28fc7083813f5a475ee154c208b5e2c9bdfc0.jpg

The multi-update journey goes on!


Earn Voyage Tokens to exchange for Doubloons and Steel.
Continue progressing toward unlocking GQ Johnny for free.
The Grand Voyage runs until January 1, 2026.


Tenth Anniversary Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ef269e09b1bdf8e74e580f4d63b20a24f608aaa3.jpg

Packed with anniversary rewards across two progression lines.


First progression line: Earn the "A Decade at Sea" flag, Blue Explosion enemy destruction effect, Commander Mikhail Orlov, and a Premium Ship VII container.
Second progression line (2,500 Doubloons): Unlocks Commander Doktor von Roth immediately. Rewards include the "Blazing Ray" and "Cold Ray" camouflages, new Italian Tier VII cruiser Optio, and "This Is Fine" enemy destruction effect.
Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).


Blast From the Past
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/73063ca79d0e83bfa45f1eda8bcf2b052b58d073.jpg

Relive the history of World of Warships in a special battle type!


Six chapters recreate different eras of the game's development: 2015, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2022, and a final modern-restriction chapter.
Surface ships only: No submarines or carriers.
12v12 Domination and Standard battles with year-based restrictions on maps and ships.


New German Cruisers: Early Access
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/77a79fcb7c8689d9f5ba413af9a11ae092e4eeb4.jpg

A brand-new cruiser branch arrives!


Deutschland, Admiral Scheer, Knesebeck, Manteuffel, and Prinz Adalbert join Early Access.
Brawling playstyle with large-caliber, short-range guns and manually controlled secondaries.
Heavy armor and improved Hydroacoustic Search, but low agility.
Permanent camouflages available for Knesebeck, Manteuffel, and Prinz Adalbert.
Sequential bundles unlock in the second week of Update 14.8.


Asymmetric Battles Return
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/42604f81a2f933f320424f85eab562f2d1efd862.jpg

Back and here for longer than ever!


Available from mid-September through Update 15.2 (five months).
Classic format: 5 human players vs. 12 AI-controlled ships, two tiers lower.
Playable on Tier VI–X ships and superships.
Expanded map pool that includes over 25 maps.


"In the Name of Tomorrow" Continues
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/67af33044ccbadb75298a884dd7e0a23ea3bd33e.jpg

Narrative Operations return for two more weeks.


Participate in Arctic Convoy, Tokyo Express, and Pacific Offensive Operations (Tier VII–IX ships).
Earn Stars through tasks to progress the campaign of U.S. Navy officer Robert Adams.
Final reward: Tier VIII San Diego.


Gameplay Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e30f70131f93f3a373873a590f25e86cafbb93b5.jpg

Polished mechanics and new options.


Module Damage Rework: Modules can no longer be permanently destroyed. Instead, they enter a new "Critically Damaged" state before automatically recovering. Reloads now pause instead of resetting.
Submarines are now playable in Operations, with increased mobility, Call Patrol Bomber support, and enabled torpedo shotgunning.
Clan Battles Season 31 "Mahi-Mahi" begins, plus Ranked Battles and three new Brawls across September and October.


The Laffey Dockyard Continues
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4205789da8d700df28945d54b2424518635c979.jpg

Build the iconic destroyer!


20 Dockyard phases (18 via missions, 2 with Doubloons). 
Available until the start of Update 14.9.


10th Anniversary Wishing Wharf
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/eddf7bb5b98a5ce52e89e991c99eb571170ee38f.jpg

Try your luck in a limited-time Armory event!


Spend Tries to roll from a large pool of rewards. 
Available throughout the anniversary celebrations.


This is just the beginning, so dive into Update 14.8 and celebrate a decade of World of Warships! Read the full update article here:

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.8
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.8. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Captains!

With Update 14.7 now out, Update 14.8 is next in line! And 14.8 is not just any old update—it'll play host to our game's 10th Anniversary megacelebration, complete with fun activities, new ships, and lots and lots of gifts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7c648a06fdd4a732a2f702182371b0cae2bc2d5e.jpg

Here's a quick breakdown of some of the most notable new content coming in 14.8:

A Decade at Sea: We've got a whole host of activities and rewards ready to go for our 10th Anniversary celebration, including Battle Performance Bonuses that can net you rewards like Tier X Japanese cruiser Kushiro; a new Port and personalized battle record to honor the game's history and the mark you left in it; and expanded log-in rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/17e5eec7be825b8cfa103b8bb09debfdeb6be734.jpg
Blast From the Past: A new temporary battle type available for all in 14.8 goes out to our most hardened veterans. This nostalgic experience unfolds over six chapters, each representing different epochs in our game's history with the appropriate ship restrictions. In addition to this, the return of Asymmetric Battles will round off the battle types introduced in this update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f33415856ea472fdc9ac27f3d20a9d0687d008b4.jpg
New German cruisers in Early Access: Cruisers Deutschland, Admiral Scheer, Knesebeck, Manteuffel, and Prinz Adalbert are entering Early Access! Built for close-quarters combat, these ships stand out for their ability to manually control their secondary batteries.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e3cf5ed3e6cd41957b810b713d4e0db1c943273a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6e29c353d479bdd8f49bcccbc87c95e74b11bcdc.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e00ba68a521c3ca72be32031dc9beaf0ea401e1d.jpg


If you want the full, detailed breakdown on these features and more, you'll have to check out our dedicated article on our website! Click through to it right here:

notes.title: Update 14.7 | In the Name of Tomorrow, Laffey Dockyard, and Grand Voyage!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a0b2d736fbf9571edaa8136b0250346c1204124e.jpg

Here's an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.7. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[previewyoutube=a4WtG-x72dE;full][/previewyoutube]

EU NA ASIA

In the Name of Tomorrow: Special Operations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4473cd835d7ffee09e657d405f87c86ba973d45.jpg

Take part in three cinematic, historically inspired Operations with unique rewards and gameplay!


Each Operation runs for a week, with all returning to rotation after 3 weeks.
Seven-player teams fight waves of bots; no submarines.
Tier and nation restrictions apply; rentals available.
Earn Stars by completing main and secondary objectives.
Unlock a narrative campaign featuring Commander Robert Adams, historical story videos, and themed rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/982ae8357622fe319a2651b695f0bdf3b939d46f.jpg
Grand prize: Tier VIII Premium cruiser San Diego; compensation in Doubloons if already owned.
Complete the campaign to unlock discounted Missouri bundles in the Armory and her Festive permanent camouflage.


80 Years Since Victory: Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03edf68c956198a287544dafa6563aa0e1f90b8c.jpg

Two progression lines with WWII-themed rewards.


First progression line: 2x War Is Over containers, the 80 Years Since Victory flag, and the Stormy Sky permanent camouflage for Nebraska.
Second progression line (2,500 Doubloons): Offers the Traditions of the North permanent camouflage for Skåne, De Grasse with Port slot, the Underwater Explosion enemy destruction effect, 2x War Is Over Premium containers, and finishes with the Traditions of the North camo for Östergötland.
Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).
Full compensation is provided in Credits if you already own any of the key rewards.


Dockyard: Laffey
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4205789da8d700df28945d54b2424518635c979.jpg

Construct U.S. Tier X destroyer Laffey—"The Ship That Would Not Die."


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2aa9f3b6d7f8bfda6a02003530c5f11eab4a446a.png
20 construction phases; 18 can be completed via missions.
Starter Packs (2 and 6 phases) available for Doubloons early on.
Laffey is a gun-focused destroyer with Burst Fire, strong concealment, a unique Smoke Generator, and an enhanced Specialized Repair Teams consumable.
Includes the Underwater Explosion enemy destruction effect.
Dockyard ends with the release of Update 14.9.


Grand Voyage: 10th Anniversary Begins
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ca89a16f863a69a0b95b884c194f4815cfebd14c.jpg

Celebrate the WoWS 10th Anniversary with our long-term event!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e44834bc6629e186fa955e9d75bcaac1dedc8d7f.jpg
Play daily to earn up to 32,000 Voyage Tokens—exchangeable 1:1 for Doubloons or Steel.
Earn iconic ship GQ Johnny (USS Johnston with battle damage) by fighting daily battles.
Missed days won't ruin progress—complete at your own pace.
Special missions and milestones, including Welcome Bonus and Daily Rewards.
Voyage Token exchange available in the Armory and on the event web page.


Aircraft Carrier & Aviation Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7151f253d0bd019b22079ba5440d6c188e2588a1.jpg

Refinements to detection, fire mechanics, and secondary battery controls.


Fires on ships now increase air detectability by 2 km (was 3 km)
All aircraft now share detectability of 10 km; spotting range increased to 20 km.
Manual control added for carrier secondaries with adjusted stats.
Standardization of air detectability and spotting across ship types.
Fires on carriers burn longer but deal less damage; Damage Control Party cooldown reduced.
HP lost to aircraft and submarine torpedoes can now be restored by the same amount regardless of hit location.


Ongoing Early Access: American Destroyers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f61b94715366724568bba99c191c2f2ce604215.jpg

American Token bundles return with artillery–focused destroyers.


Obtain Hughes, Osborne, Christopher, and Burrows via sequential bundles.
American Tokens are available in Doubloon bundles.
Includes permanent camos: "The Righteous" (Christopher) and "The Wanted" (Burrows).
Unused Tokens will be converted into Credits (1:15,000) in Update 14.8.


Brawls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3baebf40ccad6ac9b3880670c5e341a63145fb20.jpg

Three new Brawls with unique formats!


Brawl #1: 3v3; Tier VII; no destroyers, max 2 cruisers per team.
Brawl #2: 3v3; Tier IX; mixed teams, max 2 of each ship type.
Brawl #3: 2v2; Tier X; max 1 battleship + 1 cruiser per team, no carriers or submarines.


Armory Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ca207c9480b2a1297435366ec2d8d7583262c20.jpg

New additions and major expansion of the content rarity system.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5ee302c4aaa3d106b21ed7875c72ad47b3214f51.jpg
New ship: Amiral Lartigue (31,000 Steel)—French hybrid with accurate guns and skip bombers.
Content rarity system expanded to Armory items, Captain's Logbook, and Container Barge rewards.
Filter by rarity added for easier browsing.


This is just the beginning—dive into Update 14.7 and explore it all! Read the full update article here:

EU NA ASIA

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bcf8c368ecfbea9643925548d051cfb23d8fbdb3.jpg

Laffey at the Dockyard: U.S. Tier X destroyer Laffey, AKA “The Ship That Would Not Die” due to her reputation for robustness during World War II, will be available to construct at the Dockyard!

notes.title: Update 14.6 | American Destroyers, Event Pass, and Major Improvements!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/366c1cd1c943d93a9452436287ed2b3bed9dfd64.jpg
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.6. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

EU NA ASIA

[previewyoutube=5Iu9qQDj-84;full][/previewyoutube]

Early Access: American Destroyers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f202711b794b4cc244a205a4168eb0b51e1a1590.png

Welcome a new line of American destroyers with a focus on main battery firepower!


Tier VII Hughes, Tier VIII Osborne, Tier IX Christopher, and Tier X Burrows feature HE and SAP shells.
Starting from Tier VIII, they carry high-DPM 137 mm guns and have larger HP pools.
Minimal torpedo armament, low concealment capacity. These ships favor mid- to long-range engagements.
Unique toggleable Smoke Generator mechanic adds tactical flexibility.
Available via sequential bundles for American Tokens and Doubloons during Early Access.


Event Pass: American & French Flair
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/47da375a601b833620f80bf78f7e75695003a1ed.jpg

Collect new content through this classic two-line Event Pass!


First progression line: 400 American Tokens, 3 days of Premium Account, 2x French Squadron containers, and the "Go Navy!" permanent camouflage for Cleveland.
Second progression line (2,500 Doubloons): West Virginia permanent camouflage (immediate), West Virginia '41 herself, 4x French Squadron containers, 1x Journey to the West Premium container, and the French Navy permanent camouflage for Le Fantasque..
Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).


Personal Challenges Return
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7a148214a2c0115cc26efee9e408f1bedc27dcea.jpg

Back as part of Early Access for destroyers!


Runs until Update 14.7, in two sprints of two weeks each.
Earn American Tokens through Base XP milestones.


Massive Graphics & Interface Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b59be0c5ae79ef70925fe3a679606e12ccd8860.jpg

Enjoy a smoother, cleaner look!


WG Temporal Super Sampling (TSS) enhances anti-aliasing and image stability.
Container barge now features:
Faster access to container lists from the main screen.
Reward previews with drop chances.
Guaranteed reward counter.
New options for mass opening with safety confirmations.
Barge animations can now be disabled.


Content Rarity System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/75ca9533865fe7076b2a107f08cebd22874b3ac6.jpg

Understand exclusivity at a glance!


Ships, camouflages, and effects now show rarity grades: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary.
Pricing across the game aligns with these categories.
Clarifies effort vs. accessibility, but does not indicate power level.


Ship Rotation System

Streamlining the Armory and Premium Shop.


Popular ships stay available; others rotate on a scheduled basis.
First rotation: Brisbane, Almirante Grau, Nottingham, and Numancia (for Doubloons); Nottingham also for Coal.
San Diego and Leone removed, but San Diego returns in Update 14.7’s event collection; Leone remains in the Italian Destroyers collection.


Final Update: Experimental Ships & Classified Documents
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8961a02e85d40d36971b3188e86d7eb22e315332.jpg

Closing chapters on temporary mechanics.


Operations with Flagships and experimental ships end with Update 14.6.
Classified Documents now upgradeable to Level 11.
Complete experimental ship research now for final rewards in Update 14.7.
Leaderboards are live, so check your standings!


Blue Archive Collaboration: Chapter Two
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/19ac4a07d4dd0ca0b921891ccb91fe9db82d75b7.jpg

Class is back in session on the high seas!


Four new Blue Archive ships and exclusive camouflages.
Four new themed commanders with individual voiceovers.
Sail in style with Kivotos-themed flair and charm!


Grand Trial – Public Test Challenge
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg

The summer phase continues!


Earn rewards by completing tasks across test phases of Updates 14.6–14.8.
Main reward for Update 14.6: 1x Soviet Era container and 1x Soviet Era Premium container.
Complete all seasonal phases for the ultimate annual prize.


This is just the beginning, so dive into Update 14.6 and explore it all. Read the full update article here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.6. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Hey, Captains!

With Update 14.5 in full swing, it's now time to cast our eyes forward and take a sneak peek at the fun new features Update 14.6 will be delivering in just a few short weeks!

Here's a quick breakdown of some of the most notable new additions:

New U.S. destroyers: Ships of the new branch are great gunslingers and have a unique new feature—a Smoke Generator that can be toggled on or off!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e9b9b328109a58063fa135d66a665e0120260605.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f90f4a467e11d3802be6f996f34699552cea2acd.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/94bee02adb33ad945ee8102099fd32710af9f862.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b6633fe4402792831778b19f72f597c910fb5b8c.jpg
Graphical improvements: Enabling the WG Temporal Super Sampling setting in your game client will deliver sharper visuals and smoother edges without significantly impacting performance.
Rarity system: It'll soon be a lot more intuitive to understand just how unique in-game content is thanks to a new system of visual rarity for ships, camos, and beyond. This improvement goes hand-in-hand with a standardized pricing model for direct sales based on this system.
Container Barge improvements: This package of changes aims to improve your experience on the container-opening screen, with the introduction of an animation skip, better container content breakdowns, more flexible options for bulk opening, and an integrated guaranteed drop counter!


If you want the full and detailed breakdown, check out a dedicated article on our website! Click through to it right here:

notes.title: Update 14.5 | Summer Festival, Asymmetric Battles, and More!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/541fd50598417a7f28b0518642e4cdfae54d77a7.jpg

[previewyoutube=0tpNlioUJ9U;full][/previewyoutube]

Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.5. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

EU

Summer Festival Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/aaafcf2f1fbdff0959710455955ea3f70d276025.jpg

Dive into summer with our vibrant new Event Pass!


First line rewards: 3 days of Premium Account, the "Boom!" enemy destruction effect, and Commander Marina Carmen Fernández with 10 skill points and an individual voiceover.
Unlock the second line for 2,500 Doubloons to instantly receive the Pin-Up Summer permanent camouflage.
Earn Italian Tier VI Premium cruiser Duca d’Aosta and 150 Summer Tokens to spend in the Armory event.
Extra levels award More Signals containers (first line) and Rare Bonuses containers (second line).


Asymmetric Battles Return
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/99db0738249dcbd9e2e9a31d8256dde07b24638c.jpg

Take on a team of bots in this fan-favorite battle mode!


5-player teams face off against 12 bots, with a one-tier difference limit.
Playable with Tier VI–X ships and superships.
Bots are two tiers lower than player ships (excluding submarines).
Form Divisions with up to 5 players. Limited to 1 aircraft carrier, 2 battleships, 2 cruisers, 2 destroyers, and 1 submarine.


Unbreakable Line Returns – Now With Tier X!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e1297f9fe36a4246e6c344ad7cdacf38b05d90c5.jpg

The action-packed respawn mode is back with changes!


7v7 battles with Tier IX–X cruisers, battleships, and destroyers.
12-minute battles on smaller maps with respawns 15 seconds after destruction.
Victory by reaching 1,000 points or finishing the battle in the lead. No points are lost for ships sinking!
Temporary buffs on respawn; consumables do not refresh.
Expanded map pool: Big Race, Hotspot, Land of Fire, Sea of Fortune, Trident, Loop, Sleeping Giant, and Greece.


Second Group of Experimental Ships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b6f5d16f8ee65d83b084298c6989cf1c250e788f.jpg

Three new close-range brawlers enter testing!


Protector – U.S. Tier VIII cruiser

Along the way, the command ship will make two stops, where your team will receive randomized objectives to complete before continuing the journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d7e96ca8084d03f255dd0dd209542be046dce74c.jpg

Advance through the event by completing key missions and fulfilling the operation's objectives. Each mission can be thought of as a puzzle that you need to solve using the available cards. Each card represents a ship under your command, while enemy cards represent different obstacles like aircraft or coastal artillery.

The activity offers rewards like Credits, Operation Dynamo containers, and British Premium destroyer Gallant (the final reward).

Unbreakable Line
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/10bb811416e9985cbffc1cf9be94067ade3f3240.jpg

Update 14.3 introduces a new temporary battle type featuring a novel mechanic in World of Warships: respawning! It means that when your ship gets destroyed, you'll be spared a trip back to Port and will be sent back into action aboard the same ship you sailed into battle.

Format:

7v7
Tier VIII and IX; battleships, cruisers, and destroyers
Maximum battle duration: 15 minutes
Battles take place on maps of reduced size


Blücher at the Dockyard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d2c679389bf20236f4b4292fd9d6b79d97980e0.jpg

Historical German cruiser Blücher will soon be available to construct at the Dockyard! The ship stands out for her deadly accuracy and strong AP shell performance, which together help her tear through enemy broadsides like a can opener.

The ship's construction consists of 20 Dockyard phases; 18 of these will be completable through in-game combat missions. Individual phases can be purchased for Doubloons, and as usual, there are two starter pack options to get a head start.

At Phase 8, you'll pick up Commonwealth cruiser Gambia as an intermediate reward. Unlike her sister ship Fiji, Gambia has access to HE shells and Short-Burst Smoke Generator, making her a brutal combatant against enemy battleships.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cb1d22eb0ce8ed1366652c95fa23eb9f27de63b1.jpg

Efficiency Badges
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/17128fcc2a59fd3af73a25f6bbad11bf40b45acd.jpg

With Update 14.3, you'll be able to earn Efficiency Badges as a mark of personal pride for your performance aboard individual ships. After each Random Battle you finish, the Base XP you earned is tracked and compared against the recent average performance of other players globally aboard the same ship that you just played. Depending on how well you performed in comparison to your fellow players, you can receive an Efficiency Badge with one of four ranks.

You can view the Efficiency Badges for each of your ships in your profile summary, as well as on the post-battle statistics screen for the ship you sailed into battle. Only the highest-ranked badge for each of your ships will be displayed, meaning that if you upgrade a badge, it will replace the old one.

Three new ships with unique mechanics are sailing out on our seas! Designed for bold Captains, these vessels bring high-risk, high-reward gameplay:


These experimental ships start each battle with reduced HP but can heal over time. Where it gets very interesting is that their main battery accuracy and rate of fire improve as their HP decreases. Will you choose the security of HP or the risky but satisfying firepower route?
Armed with a limited stock of AP shells with improved characteristics and Burst Fire mode.
They have no module upgrades, their economic earnings are similar to same-tier Tech Tree ships, and Commanders assigned to experimental ships do not require retraining.

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.1. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU 

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

“Remembrance of Ming's Past” Adventure

The Seven Voyages of Zheng He are famous across China. Sent by the Ming dynasty to improve relations with foreign powers and bolster trade, Zheng He commanded huge fleets loaded with expensive gifts and trade goods to such far places as Hormuz in the Persian Gulf and Mogadishu in Africa. We are honoring this famous explorer in a new adventure that will run through Updates 14.1 and 14.2 and will provide many opportunities to earn your own World of Warships riches along the way!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/15ae6951bde38a9509c4e8c636605ac6add6abe1.jpg

During this adventure, completing missions will earn you the new "The Ming Legacy" flag and Zheng He's Voyages patch, as well as some Adventure Tokens that you can spend on various containers in the Armory. Alternatively, you can exchange them for Ming's Voyage Tokens that you can use to obtain thematic rewards: new IX Taihang
, the Chinese Treasure Ship permanent camouflage for her, and Commander Zheng He himself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1a442e238f1e0c580480532411a82a388f27bc1f.jpg

"The Finest Hour" Collection and a New Unique Dutch Commander

Conrad Helfrich was a lieutenant admiral of the Royal Netherlands Navy and overall commander of the Dutch naval forces in Southeast Asia during World War II. In the first stages of the Pacific War, he was one of the most successful Allied commanders in that theater. We honor this military juggernaut with a special collection dedicated to his memory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d79fe6a5c993339fc5c8aebd86867853686f3bbd.jpg

You can get collection elements from the "The Finest Hour" standard containers, which you can obtain in exchange for Adventure Tokens earned from adventure missions. It’s possible to earn enough Adventure Tokens to complete the collection in its entirety.

Note that you must make a choice to either get the unique Dutch Commander for Adventure Tokens or save them and spend on IX Taihang
after the Adventure ends. Tokens obtainable from missions and bundles for resources in the Armory can’t cover both rewards.

notes.title: Update 14.0: Dutch Cruisers
notes.notes:
You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website: 

EU NA ASIA

[previewyoutube=5hBdPFluC2g;full][/previewyoutube]

Early Access to Dutch Cruisers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/490e7cece3ca4faa2579dfe1b7d682a46e2f336a.jpg

Early Access to a new line of Dutch light cruisers begins with the start of Update 14.0.
Branch highlights

This line features 128 mm main battery guns with good range and ballistics.
For this caliber, their AP shells can deal good damage, while their HE shells have good penetration capabilities but leave much to be desired in terms of damage and fire-starting chances.
The ships are also armed with a signature Dutch Airstrike with a fast cooldown, long range, and the ability to reach the target relatively quickly. On the flip side, the squadron size is only small.
The line boasts good concealment and strong AA defenses, and the ships also come equipped with Engine Boost and a Repair Party with a short cooldown.
As for their weaknesses, ships of the line have small HP pools and weak armor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/109b5f888178138c9b8a0a33a6d6aeef03868d1c.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d3278e610a2efc54496b38ae43fb201a0daf86fc.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6036535977907ecb8fc8340621a3bdfb251f6c7a.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9f459a5bea762d8bf16b14d04c1e52a3bdafbfa4.jpg

Dutch Cruisers Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1fa4f38386fa874e9eb080ba47e25a4e88c3b777.jpg

To celebrate the arrival of these three beauties in our virtual seas, we've prepared a Dutch-themed Event Pass for you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ac8e69c1a7bc9bbb027bc1ca07855c4ff810dc20.jpg
The first progression line offers rewards like the Flying Dutchman permanent camouflage, Royal Netherlands Navy permanent camouflages for 
VII Eendracht, VIII Haarlem, and newcomer cruiser VIII Jaarsveld as the final reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1390405db95395f0718db3cdd26a1e8a7d984f99.jpg
Unlocking the second progression line for 2,500 Doubloons will allow you to claim even more themed items. You’ll immediately receive the Lion's Heart permanent camouflage for 
VIII Jaarsveld, and progressing down the line will bring you Royal Netherlands Navy permanent camouflages for IX Johan de Witt and X Gouden Leeuw.

Operations with Flagships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a1b586a4b769f94a38c9dfe4c974cd738d264a30.jpg

Throughout Update 14.0, you can participate in Operations with flagships, available as a separate battle type. There are three types of flagships—Incendiary Specialist, Torpedo Master, and Iron Fist—all boasting increased HP and provide bots in the nearby area with particular effects.
Taking down these formidable flagships will require you to take advantage of the knowledge that each of them is particularly vulnerable to a certain type of damage. Make sure to choose which ship to deploy in each battle carefully, based on the enemy's weaknesses. When making your choices, keep in mind that you'll only face flagships of a specific type per week for the first 3 weeks. Your most versatile ships will be best suited for the battles of the fourth week, as you'll face all three types of flagships!

And Much, Much More!

notes.title: Update 13.11 | Happy Holidays!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d24f978565fa7c2c8dd9e6dd3ee0ce968f928ec7.jpg
This is a short overview of some of the content introduced in Update 13.11. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

EU NA ASIA

Claim Your Free Ship: Expedition to the North Pole
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4cbef8cfa309186cfee851c654c8256683abedf2.jpg

Destination reached, Captain! With the arrival of December comes the end of the Expedition to the North Pole event. The next step is claiming your gift! 

If you've actively participated in the Expedition this autumn, you can receive a Tier X Tech Tree ship along with some extra rewards; and if you're only just hearing about it now and haven't earned any Expedition Tokens at all, you can still claim a Tier VIII Tech Tree ship—guaranteed!

To claim it, just log in to the game from December 1. If you choose a ship that you already have in your Port, you'll receive Free XP as compensation instead.

Wonders of the Arctic
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bdf377c7066b45021f140680ec27479f56fe1c48.jpg

We’ve prepared a special celebration as another year comes to a close, so you can be sure that Update 13.11 will bring lots of gifts and activities.


Nordlyshavn Port: a magical new Port will light your way through the new update. Keep an eye out for interactive elements, including a Christmas Tree that you can decorate by completing a set number of battles each day. Hang enough ornaments, and you'll even earn a Santa's Gift container!
Advent Calendar: From December 1 through 25, you can open one of the Calendar’s cards each day and claim the gift it hides. 
Festive Rewards: A holiday tradition in World of Warships, you can now once again collect rewards for earning Base XP on your Tier V and higher ships. The rewards include Festive Certificates, which you can exchange for both types of Santa's Gifts containers in the Armory!
Update to Santa's containers: Only two types of containers are available this year—Santa’s Gift and Santa’s Mega Gift. We’ve removed 23 older ships from the drop list and added 18 new ones. They can also drop a special new Golden Gift container, which holds ships Chikuma II, Prins van Oranje, and Georg Hoffmann, as well as their golden versions!
Niord and Kalmar Dockyard: The construction of European battleship Niord has commenced at the Hamburg Dockyard! This year, you can also unlock new European destroyer Kalmar as an intermediate reward at the 8th shipbuilding phase of the Dockyard!


Event Pass: East and West
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/55852736bb5109723645738e76601481dbf1d451.jpg

Update 13.11 features two themed Event Pass chapters dedicated to our two explorers, Li Wei and Olaf Lundgren. Each chapter lasts for 3 weeks, features 25 levels, and functions as a standalone Event Pass.


Chapter 1: In the first progression line, you'll find Commander Li Wei with a unique voiceover, along with the Butterfly Kaleidoscope enemy destruction effect, the Avid Explorer patch, and some Santa's Gift containers. The second line offers the Adventure's Call flag, the Eastbound permanent camouflage, Santa's Gift containers, 1x Santa's Mega Gift container, and Pan-Asian Tier VII battleship Teng She with a festive permanent camouflage!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65487271619233b611ebac360f8aa7afb32b5053.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e125092c7d2baca1819270369436d1e5bd444b8f.jpg
Chapter 2: The first progression line will reward you with the Polar Pursuit patch, Commander Olaf Lundgren with an individual voiceover, the Avalanche enemy destruction effect, and Santa's Gift containers. The second line offers the Echoes of the Past flag, the Westbound permanent camouflage, Santa's Gift containers, 1x Santa's Mega Gift container, and European Tier VII battleship Lugdunum with an icy permanent camouflage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d15b456553c5605f94f49b86eb2cbb523a6e5711.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/94482bd0a9d44a8a3dc0a2287f9130c8871343e8.jpg



STAR TREK: Final Operation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e472c1e7f95ab3343eb2e9534e6020b7d5492d26.jpg

The final of the three STAR TREK Operations is unfolding during the first two weeks of Update 13.11. 

The invasion is intensifying and the Vulcans are in imminent danger—only through the combined efforts of Starfleet's finest can we ensure their survival. Ready your ships by raising shields and going to red alert, and rally your crews to join the fight and protect Vulcan from assimilation!

If her drone minions fail, the Borg Queen herself will join the battle to crush the united forces of the Federation, Klingons, Romulans, and Vulcans. Will you emerge victorious in the face of her wrath?

And Much, Much More!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/30c4d268034f7405a72659f455799b6af0c58bc2.jpg

This is not even close to all of the new features added in this, the most wonderful update of the year! Read our full update article via the link below to learn about:


The return of Asymmetric Battles
The removal of the detonation mechanic
The new Clan Patrols activity
A new season of Clan Battles
Five new rounds of Brawls
The Steel Will Armory event
And more!

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.11 Round 3
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.11. For more information, visit the relevant link:

EU NA ASIA

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

Wonders of the Arctic

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/e2c0a9f1177b397881e83c01a5dd1f5cdf5a300a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/fe3aba1ac3ec10454a6f269989f8dcc1047a8856.jpg

13.11 is our New Year update, so we've naturally prepared a festive atmosphere for you to enjoy both in your Port and on the battlefield.


You'll visit the new Port of Nordlyshavn, where you can decorate your very own Christmas Tree with ornaments that can be unlocked by completing missions.
A special Advent Calendar will replace the standard daily rewards from December 1 through 25.
You can earn Festive Rewards for all the Tier V+ ships in your Port!
Unwrap Santa's Gift containers, streamlined to two types—Santa's Gift and Santa's Mega Gift—both stuffed with a new rotation of ships!
Light your enemies up like a Christmas Tree with three new holiday-themed enemy destruction effects.


Removal of Magazine Detonation

Based on player feedback, we've decided to change our stance on the magazine detonation mechanic and are going to remove it from the game entirely starting with Update 13.11

This change goes hand-in-hand with another series of changes, including the removal of the Juliet Charlie signal, which will be replaced with the new Charlie Kilo signal, increasing ship HP and squadron HP by +5% and +2.5%, respectively. The Magazine Modification 1 upgrade will be removed entirely, and all of its owners will automatically receive full compensation in Credits.

Event Pass

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/b66b3c58dbff74de76ffc1ebfd692921ca1fa06b.jpg

Our heroes Li Wei and Olaf Lundgren are nearing the end of their expedition to the North Pole! Update 13.11 features two themed Event Pass chapters, each dedicated to an explorer you’ve already met in a previous update.

Advancing through the Event Pass levels will bring you Commanders Li Wei and Olaf Lundgren, plus various awesome rewards like ships!

Each Event Pass chapter lasts for 3 weeks, features 25 levels and functions as a standalone Pass. This means that once the first chapter ends, you won’t be able to complete it retroactively!

Star Trek Operation—Queen's Rage

The final chapter of our STAR TREK Operations unfolds in Update 13.11. At the beginning of the Operation, you must defend three control points at risk of falling to the Borg. You’ll face three enemy waves, each led by a powerful minion.

If you successfully defeat all the Borg Queen's minions, she'll have no choice but to join the fight herself…

The third phase of the Star Trek Operation reward track offers Steel, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, special and rare economic bonuses, signals, Star Tokens, and collection items.

Dockyard: Niord

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/c89af567bd662a85c1412ae40394510b9165266e.jpg

Construction of European Tier IX battleship Niord is commencing at the Hamburg Dockyard. The ship features eight accurate 380 mm main battery guns with a fast reload. She also boasts 20 torpedo tubes with a tight spread, fast speed, and long range.

One of the intermediate rewards is European Tier V destroyer Kalmar, which can be found at the 8th shipbuilding phase.

The Dockyard construction process consists of 20 phases, 18 of which you can advance through via combat missions, while the rest can be purchased for Doubloons. Each shipbuilding phase costs 3,000 Doubloons. Starter packs of two and six phases can be purchased for 5,000 and 12,600 Doubloons, respectively. 

Asymmetric Battles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/1c29a1317b724297d090ffd56bc1edb663e12453.jpg

The beloved battle type where you fight as a team of five against superior bot-controlled forces has returned!


You can play Tier VI–X ships and superships
Five ships to a team on the player side
Maximum difference of one tier between the ships
You can play any ship type


Clan Patrols

Update 13.11 also delivers a temporary new activity—Clan Patrols—available for all Clan members. Inside the special Patrol window under the Clan tab, you can choose a battle type for Patrols and receive extra rewards just by playing it!

notes.title: Update 13.10: What's New
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of some of the content introduced in Update 13.10. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

EU NA ASIA

STAR TREK Operations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8d8fbbf4b3892d715a8189022d337cb805983ba6.jpg

The relentless Borg have invaded the planet Vulcan—and it’s up to you and your allies to resist the onslaught with phasers, shields, and good old-fashioned kinetic firepower in the new STAR TREK Operations!


The first and second Operations go live during Update 13.10, and the third one will become available at the start of Update 13.11.
Each Operation will last for 2 weeks and feature special STAR TREK-themed rental ships, new weapons, and shield mechanics, as well as a new module mechanic for upgrading them. This new mechanic lets you mix and match different module sets, changing the types of armaments present on your chosen ship, as well as consumables and special auxiliary systems.


Complete secondary missions to earn the Stars necessary to warp through the reward track quickly. You can unlock module upgrade packs and rewards such as days of Premium Account; Star Tokens; eight elements of the new "Space, the Final Frontier" collection; "To Boldly Go" and Assimilated permanent camouflages, resources, and more!

Black Friday Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4a31b65abe5fabecd36cd9c112fdb76997793d0.jpg


The Black Fleet sails again this November, highlighted by the spotlight of our new Event Pass!


The first progression line offers a new enemy destruction effect that you can link to any of your ships. Black Friday 2024 standard and Premium containers also await you along with days of Warships Premium Account, a Port slot, and more. 
For 2,500 Doubloons, you can unlock the second progression line, which offers French battleship Dunkerque B, Commander Jeremie Noel with 10 skill points, Black Friday 2024 standard and Premium containers, and more. 


More Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a0ffe2b2163786359e362447ccb0c9cc2a2be325.jpg

That's far from everything Update 13.10 has to offer! Check out a dedicated article on our website to get the full intel about the full release of the Pan-American battleship Tech Tree branch, a new Ranked Battles season, a new stage of the Expedition to the North Pole, and more:

STAR TREK Operations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5a459e3bf720b927b8e22e0dd164fab0cb84a522.jpg

In the second wave of our collaboration with STAR TREK, you can dive into three exciting Operations, each lasting 2 weeks, spanning Updates 13.10 and 13.11.

The Operations unfold on the planet Vulcan during an attack from the Borg Collective. You must take control of ships representing the Federation,  the Federation, Vulcan, Klingon Empire, and Romulan Star Empire factions.

In the new STAR TREK Port, you can follow your reward track progress, upgrade your ships, and explore a themed collection. Iconic STAR TREK memorabilia will grace your Captain's quarters, and collecting its elements will provide battle bonuses for the event's Operations.

New weapons and shield mechanics are available, with phasers, pulse phasers, and photon torpedoes. The event introduces a unique system for upgrading your ships, with the use of unlockable modules affecting primary weapons, secondary weapons, hulls, and shields. Combining the different modules in various ways will change the configuration of ship stats, armaments, and consumables; or even unlock Combat Instructions.

Black Friday Event Pass

It's getting to that time of the year! This year, we've got even more ships, containers, Coal, Steel, and a new custom enemy destruction effect—Monochrome!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cbc13e3f7be2d6af45b743e518841349c8e8948b.jpg


The first progression line brings Black Friday 2024 Premium and standard containers, 3 days of Warships Premium Account, economic rewards, and a new enemy destruction effect.

Arena

A new high-stakes Brawl event is coming your way! During the first week of the event, a special mission chain will become purchasable in the Armory for 10,000 Coal. After making the purchase, you can proceed to 3v3 Brawls playing Tier IX battleships, cruisers, and destroyers. Every victory will earn you rewards!


You must win seven times to complete the mission chain.
You can lose an occasional battle, but no more than three battles in total.
Completing the chain will bring you the final reward—500 Steel.
If you lose more than three times, the chain will break, you'll be rewarded with 3x More Coal containers, and you'll have to start from scratch by purchasing another mission chain.

notes.title: Update 13.9: Red October
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b699c4debf5f98d5060751143f30bf8edb037366.jpg
This is a short overview of some of the content introduced in Update 13.9. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

Mode Shuffle 2.0
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/738b2620f8c34ae176c0ce639d456af2667aaeae.jpg

The dynamic battle type that randomly places you in one of three different game modes has returned for Update 13.9, with some interesting changes. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9691b8b5ebf6123b31c3fa4d3066974db9e6f5ce.jpg


German-Themed Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7841152ad1bcaf5220b04f197b96820bb113a25f.jpg

Update 13.9's event pass, titled "Unity, Justice, Freedom" pays homage to Germany's Reunification Day both in name and in content:


The first progression line includes "Black, Red, and Gold" and "Black, White, Red" permanent camouflages, the German Navy permanent camouflage for Prinz Heinrich, and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for Prinz Rupprecht
The second progression line can be unlocked with 2,500 Doubloons, and grants tier VI destroyer Karl von Schönberg immediately, followed by the German Navy permanent camouflage for Zieten, Commander Willie Neumann, 1x German Squadron Premium container, and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for Schlieffen

The Bounty status can be purchased up to 80 times from the Armory for 100,000 Credits, with the first three purchases being free. You lose the Bounty status when your ship gets destroyed or the event ends.

You can get a temporary currency called Red Tokens if you earn special achievements, as well as for destroying ships while having the Bounty status active. Red October Leaderboard

As you advance through the adventure, you will learn the history of this battle as you complete missions and earn new Leyte Gulf containers and Leyte tokens, the latter of which you can exchange for containers guaranteed to drop Tier VI–IX Premium ships, the "I Shall Return" permanent camouflage for Tennessee, the Ghost of the Pacific permanent camouflage for Enterprise, as well as eight 10-skill-point historical Commanders, and more

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f6a76637cba4c759be6d8626c8612a179569f7e1.jpg


The first progression line rewards "Black, Red, and Gold" and "Black, White, Red" permanent camouflages, along with the German Navy permanent camouflage for P. Heinrich and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for P. Rupprecht.
Unlocking the second progression line will let you get your hands on Premium destroyer Karl von Schönberg, the German Navy permanent camouflage for Zieten, the German Eagle permanent camouflage for Schlieffen, German Commander Willie Neumann, and a German Squadron Premium container.


"Red October" Bounty Hunt

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9068aef89fcb35239192e703856de6bfec46dab5.jpg

The dynamic Bounty Hunt experience is returning to the seas of World of Warships, this time with a Soviet-themed coat of paint.

The goal is to sink Bounty ships or earn the Bounty achievement in Random Battles. If you choose to take on the Bounty status for yourself, your goal will be to sink ships and earn achievements.

You can get the Bounty status in the Armory in exchange for 100,000 Credits, and each player can purchase up to 80 Bounty statuses during the event, with the first three being free. The Bounty status will be removed once your ship is destroyed or the event ends.

Rewards include Soviet Era containers, Victory Banner permanent camouflages for several Soviet ships, Victory permanent camouflages, and Coal. 

During the first week of the event, you'll be able to track the total number of Bounties destroyed and earn various goodies in the exciting and rewarding Leaderboard competition. The top 10 players in each region will receive Premium Tier VIII submarine S-189, or 5,000 Steel if they already have this ship in their fleet. The top 11–25 will get 3x Soviet Era Premium containers, and the top 26–50 players will get 1,000 Steel.

notes.title: Update 13.8: World of Warships Anniversary!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/10ad804367ef903b961dc1150efa0c4b6983a8db.jpg
This is a short overview of some of the content that is introduced in Update 13.8. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

EU

Anniversary Celebrations!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b8d3289d7c9af6ccf906556d23d76c76b6181a95.jpg

World of Warships will be turning 9 years old this month! In our usual fashion, we are throwing an all-out party full of Festive Rewards and events for our players!

Festive Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/95a5586c65cfefdbfad282a83dbddc5ab90ca052.jpg

As is tradition, throughout our Anniversary update you can unlock special rewards for achieving certain Base XP thresholds aboard any and all Tier V+ ships in your Port. And this year, we've made it easier than ever!

Your rewards will consist of Festive Tokens, a currency that can be exchanged in the Armory for Tier VIII American cruiser Rochester, Battle of Paso de Patria containers, the Stellar Pioneer permanent camouflage for Benson, Supercontainers, and much, much more!

New Collection
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c9537e7375f9c136ee7d5f38ccea02ce5b9e004a.jpg

It's been a long time coming and now it's finally here! To celebrate our anniversary, we have a brand-new in-game puzzle collection for you to complete! 

There are 60 elements in total, which you can get from Battle of Paso de Patria standard and Premium containers. The final reward for completing the collection will be new unique Pan-American Commander Joaquim Marques Lisboa.

Aquatica Fair
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0979855bfaabab52d50be520ad8a86f4388fb6e1.jpg

A new event has entered the Armory! In the Aquatica Fair event, you'll spend Tries to earn items from a large reward pool that includes new Tier IX Spanish battleship Victoria, Tier IX European battleship Karl XIV Johan, Tier VIII German battleship Anhalt, the Galactic Wanderer permanent camouflage for Victoria, and other anniversary-themed permanent camouflages from past years. 

Pan-American Battleships in Early Access
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b481018abe679670823d977cc432ac3655be8cda.jpg

Be the first to try out the first Pan-American line of battleships in the game with our latest Early Access event! Battleships Ipiranga, Los Andes, and Libertad are awaiting your command, each with a large number of guns they can bring to bear. 

To complement this setup, the ships have access to a Combat Instructions mechanic that, when activated, improves the range, damage, and reload time of their secondary batteries. To charge the Combat Instructions meter, you must either score hits with your main battery guns or accumulate potential damage.

In addition, the Pan-American battleships have access to an enhanced Repair Party consumable that restores a higher amount of HP.

As for downsides, gun-for-gun, their main batteries have lower range and firepower than the equivalent ships of other nations, and their citadels are vulnerable to enemy shells when the ships' broadsides are exposed.

Operations Battle Type Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2a1ada51a9193d27d8e7236ed6de6c7aa6d9dcf7.jpg

Update 13.8 will introduce changes to Operations. These changes will affect Naval Station Newport, Raptor Rescue, The Ultimate Frontier, Hermes, Aegis, and Cherry Blossom. We have expanded the range of tiers that can participate in these 6 Operations, allowing you to bring your Tier VI–X ships and superships into battle.

More Novelties and Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/db3ae586646e34d26b052961542d6c4606ce7cc6.jpg


New Season of Ranked Battles: Season 19 begins this week with the Bronze, Silver, and Gold Leagues in a 6 vs. 6 format on Tiers VI and VII, VIII and IX, and X and superships, respectively.
New Clan Battles Season: Codenamed "Asp," the new season of this competitive battle type will be played in a 7 vs. 7 format aboard Tier VIII battleships, destroyers, and cruisers.
Expedition to the North Pole: The road to the New Year begins here! Leading up to December, complete special combat mission chains during each update, then collect rewards such as ships and Santa's Gift containers as you progress.
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Get ready to welcome new Commanders, totally rad permanent camouflages, Pizza Time Premium containers, and more themed content later in Update 13.8. Stay tuned for more information!
System Requirements Update: We've updated the system requirements for World of Warships based on our latest performance tests to provide our players with the most optimal hardware configurations. Game client performance should not change for current users.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5960fd8e44cb5b76681eda080aa3a62cffc2e3f5.jpg

Your main goal is to place as many minefields as possible in the way of the attackers, with the bonus tasks being to save as many coastal guns as possible and destroy the Allied destroyers, battleships, and aircraft carrier while surviving until Axis reinforcements arrive. Lastly, if one of your teammates is destroyed, a buff will be activated for your team so you can continue the fight.

Omaha Beach Assault
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c83ce9f4d63421c42d0201e100261bed10d68e3e.jpg

The final D-day scenario will put you back on the Allied side on the same map from the previous Operation.

Your team can consist of Tier V–VII battleships, cruisers, and destroyers from Great Britain; the U.S.A.; the Commonwealth; France; and the Netherlands, as well as select European ships.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/40be56daab0a4509e079ea78d90ae2c9acaaa278.jpg

This time, your mission is to rescue the crews of the damaged vessels and then destroy the very same coastal batteries you were defending in the prior Operation. Other tasks include destroying all the Schnellboots, escorting the attacking force, defeating the remaining destroyers, and having half of your team still standing at the end of it all.

notes.title: Update 13.4: D-day Anniversary
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the content in Update 13.4. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6470526d9b9d6abd45af0944211a015e5dc6353d.jpg

EU NA ASIA

D-Day
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6daa905594e67740d7ed0f5275de34b0b8a76ac2.jpg

In honor of this incredible military operation, three new Operations are coming to World of Warships in a new event battle type!

Starts: May 30

The first Operation will be available in Update 13.4, while the second and third Operations will become available in Update 13.5. Each Operation will last for 2 weeks, feature Tier V–VII ships, and accommodate up to 6 players in a Division.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a64c38fe2da88ab0ae3494c165cca2fad465056a.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/250378a0ef563573d185a9501afdee5e91e3a69a.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cffc49b1b7b3fd9f093dab7543b795a0945a0968.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2faf75c9f0dc3940ced3d9e8df0f1c9e86fb65b8.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/129d53977842b1246aebd501acc3304411137849.jpg

In the first Operation, you'll take command of the Allied vanguard spearheading the landings on Utah Beach. You'll have to fight through enemy naval forces and suppress coastal defenses to ensure the safe arrival of your landing craft.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fc2e23fad0be77e00d5be9992adcd77d0d9140cd.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/26faf499dc66e9cbc17a449e34bd321d01ac4e17.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c22722dda2afcd543b59f10828f840a13467c392.jpg


Classified Documents
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b66887e5160e06fb0f5f882ef9041ed0edf61680.jpg

As part of the Operations commemorating D-Day, we're introducing a special event mechanic called "Classified Documents." These provide bonuses against specific enemy types, and they come in three different levels: Confidential, Secret, and Top Secret, with each level providing additional bonuses.

Azur Lane Wave 6
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/189263c160570c5fea7672cc23e87ea621a4d5ce.jpg

World of Warships and Azur Lane are joining forces once again! Update 13.4 will welcome the Sixth Wave of our collaboration! This time, the already impressive list of Azur Lane Commanders will be joined by five newcomers with individual voiceovers: Shimakaze, Ägir, Hornet, Queen Elizabeth, and Fusō; moreover, three new ships will be added to the game—AL Shimakaze, AL Ägir, and AL Hornet, as well as commemorative flags for the new ships.

Azur Lane Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/dd4cc33abc2852d0fd422cf4d03cfa450ed1be51.jpg

But that's not all! Update 13.4 brings a new thematic Event Pass that features new content from the Azur Lane collaboration!

"Among the special rewards of the first progression line, you'll be able to obtain Azur Lane containers, an Azur Lane permanent camouflage for 
Queen Elizabeth, plus Commander Queen Elizabeth with an individual voiceover and 10 skill points."

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.4 Round 3
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.4. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

EU 

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

80th Anniversary of D-Day

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/26383e173507b71ebf5ccf13aec8cceb4e642d29.jpg

On the morning of June 6, 1944, the full force of the Western Allied powers was brought to bear against Germany's Atlantic Wall on the beaches of Normandy, in what amounted to the largest amphibious invasion in History.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7886355c06078a0941b7dd78308e0c3c20dee45c.jpg

80 years on, we're commemorating it in World of Warships with three brand-new event Operations spread across Updates 13.4 and 13.5:

[olist]
Clear the way for landing craft at Utah Beach by suppressing German defenses.
Take command of German destroyers and delay the arrival of Allied forces at Omaha Beach.
Mount a daring rescue operation at Omaha Beach as an Allied ship.
[/olist]

Each Operation will be available for 2 weeks, and you'll be able to participate in Divisions of up to 6 players helming Tier V–VII destroyers, cruisers, and battleships.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/44a817e6edcbc4b6f9a94f3a5e5232cd35bb7c2f.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8d836127db6eb2ed6f5ac28348a73811e9f7bc58.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/365bb03e7e8f7bfc32bed9e215edc69d6ed9e337.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fd9423f4cc86d2a931971c71b8b23c67c838b776.jpg

The D-Day Operations only have a single difficulty level, and completing the primary objective will not be the hardest part. There will, however, be a series of secondary objectives that will grant you Stars and increase the overall difficulty of the Operation. The Stars will progress you through a special reward track, giving you the opportunity to earn new Classified Document options.

New Mechanic: Classified Documents
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/775feeb0bcde9046e63a593340da6834e463b026.jpg

A special mechanic, Classified Documents, will be available in these Operations and can be activated against certain enemy groups for additional bonuses. Each Document has three levels: "Confidential," "Secret," and "Top Secret." Each new level grants an additional bonus to the existing Classified Document option.

There are twelve options in total—six Allied and six Axis—and players receive one option per side at the start of the event. Only three can be brought into an Operation at a time. You can either choose them in the Port manually before battle or during a short window of time after the Operation begins.

Clan Battles 25: Support Consumables

Clan Battles Season 25, codenamed "Polar Bear," will be shorter than usual due to its experimental nature—we're adding some of the support consumables you may be familiar with from the recent Piñata Hunt event. These special consumables will provide advantages to you and your team.

To keep teams balanced with these support consumables active, there will be restrictions on the number of consumables that can be taken into battle per Division, as well as restrictions on which types can equip certain consumables.

notes.title: Update 13.3: Wisconsin at the Dockyard
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the content in Update 13.3. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website.

EU NA ASIA

Dockyard: Wisconsin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ef364293a6bc8d5ada89b48e7f04864d2b93e3a.jpg

Build the historic American battleship in Update 13.3! 

Ship features:

"Immediate Systems Reload" Combat Instructions that reduce your consumable preparation/cooldown time.
Accurate guns that inflict relatively low damage.
High speed and good concealment, but relatively weak armor.


The shipbuilding process consists of 30 phases, 28 of which can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat missions. When you reach shipbuilding phase 20, you'll also be rewarded with West Virginia '44. If you already have her in your fleet, you'll receive three Dockyard phases instead; so, with that and completing enough combat missions, you can earn Wisconsin completely free!

The Dockyard combat missions can be completed during Updates 13.3 and 13.4, while the Dockyard will remain available until the start of Update 13.6.

Golden Week Festivities
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e6753837edff1754bc47bf106e29b9e8e3feb0e4.jpg

The new update welcomes a new Event Pass dedicated to the special holiday celebrated in Japan and East Asian countries!

The Event Pass consists of two 20-level progression lines.


Among the rewards of the first progression line, you'll find Romanian Commander Andrei Teodorescu, permanent camouflages, a permanent bonus package for Tier VII ships, and Golden Tokens.
For the second progression line, you can expect the Japanese Lacquer permanent camouflage for Kongō, the Dawn Harmony permanent camouflage for Shimanto and Takahashi, a permanent bonus package for a Tier VIII ship, new Japanese Commander Ashikaga Teru, and Doubloons.


Golden Tokens can be spent at the Wishing Wharf event in the Armory.

Wishing Wharf
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/01df299422d76f424a4d95fd41141bf3fd838157.jpg

During the Wishing Wharf event, you can spend Golden Tokens to try to get random rewards. Each Try will cost you 100 Golden Tokens.

The event rewards are separated into three categories based on their rarity:


Common rewards: Special and rare economic bonuses, Free and Elite Commander XP, Credits, and signals.
Rare rewards: Hyūga, Maya, new hybrid cruiser Chikuma II, and Hayate, as well as themed permanent camouflages for Hyūga, Maya, Mogami, Hayate, and Yamato.
Supreme reward: Chikuma II Golden with characteristics similar to Chikuma II but a unique appearance.


Asymmetric Battles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c4c1780b25e915cf7b20737d40c77d42bd43fbec.jpg

Here's some good news for PvE fans—we've decided to bring Asymmetric Battles back for the entire duration of Update 13.3!

The rules haven't changed since the last iteration, and as for the bots, they'll continue to be a 12-ship team two tiers lower than each tier represented in the player team.

Leaderboard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/017a09980250a0ff1100fd1064f71e3721a50f6c.jpg

A new Armory activity starts in May! Join the competition and earn cumulative Base XP in all battle types. You'll be able to track your progress, as your position will be updated hourly.
The top 5 players in each realm will be rewarded with Tsurugi, while the top 6 to 50 players will get a discount coupon for the purchase of Tsurugi. All participants who earn at least 3,000 Base XP during the event will get 500 Community Tokens as a reward.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.3
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.3. For more information about the upcoming features and rewards for participating in the Public Test, visit the dedicated article on our website:

EU NA ASIA

Wisconsin at the Dockyard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2150f445060a7fa3c5f0d26b8e961e5c125fc2fa.jpg

Wisconsin is coming to the Dockyard! The construction process consists of 30 phases, 28 of which can be completed via combat mission groups. If you complete all the Dockyard missions, you'll only need to purchase two phases to get the new ship!

Completing phase 20 will award you with Tier VII Premium battleship West Virginia '44! If you already own her, you'll instead get three construction phases, potentially allowing you to earn Wisconsin for free!

Asymmetric Battles
