The fan-favorite PvE battle type is returning! Battles will be fought in a 5 vs. 12 format and feature Tier VI–X ships, including superships. While human players will be able to select any ship type, submarines won't be an option for the bot-controlled team.

For the player team, the maximum tier difference between ships will be limited to one, while bots will control ships up to two tiers lower.

Golden Week Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7aa770542ca9e3b4d8d4b1f165795a8e34366c90.jpg

The Event Pass for Update 13.3 is themed around Japan's Golden Week holidays.

The first progression line holds Asian Lantern and Golden Week permanent camouflages, a permanent economic package for a Tier VII ship, Golden Tokens, and more!

The second progression line holds the Japanese Lacquer permanent camouflage for Kongō, the Dawn Harmony permanent camouflage for Shimanto or Takahashi, a permanent economic package for a Tier VIII ship, new Japanese Commander Ashikaga Teru, and Doubloons.

Custom Destruction Animation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/99210682e517299b061238cf7965e3ef9000514f.gif

We're testing a new concept in Update 13.3 – a permanent camouflage that adds a custom destruction animation to ships you destroy instead of the standard explosion.

You can get one of these camouflages for free during Update 13.3 and can purchase three additional ones for Credits.

notes.title: Update 13.2: Piñata Hunt
notes.notes:
EU NA ASIA

Piñata Hunt
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/43e491a8e803ecd8aad5d54999e43edbf4fd0e1c.png

Update 13.2 brings the Piñata Hunt event! You'll be able to hunt a special Piñata ship during the event to gain an advantage over your opponents. Available as a separate battle type, this year’s event features the specially decorated Colorful Islands map.

Details

Battles with Tier VIII–IX ships of all types; 7 players per team.
When the Piñata is taken down, a shrinking control point will spawn on the spot where it sinks.


The Piñata Hunt also introduces a new mechanic—support consumables. There are eight unique support consumables in total, with each ship type having access to five of them. One consumable for each ship type will be unlocked at the start, while up to four others can be attained by completing missions or by purchasing them with Credits in the Armory. You'll be able to select only one support consumable per battle.

During the Piñata Hunt event, you can obtain Piñata Tokens by completing combat missions. You can exchange these Tokens for rewards in the Armory.

Early Access to Commonwealth Cruisers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/85b27abea5aef1475e167d647258bdcd5adc59d1.png

The long-awaited Commonwealth cruisers enter Early Access in Update 13.2!

To celebrate their arrival, the following themed permanent camouflages are being added to the game: Indian Tiger for Delhi, New Zealand Fern for Auckland, and Australian Ornament for Cerberus. Additionally, historical Commanders Harold Farncomb and Leonard Murray, the Commonwealth Rockfish patch, the Commonwealth Team commemorative flag, and Commonwealth Team Premium containers are being added to the game.

Keep your eyes glued to our website for the special article covering these new cruisers!

Commonwealth Team Event Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4fe64ed6fa67a8bc8551a936d9ea6ec58e06b10b.png

Update 13.2 brings a new thematic Event Pass! You can participate in it and journey through two progression lines that offer loads of rewards. Each line comprises a total of 20 levels—complete them to earn all the main rewards and gain access to additional rewards for completing extra levels.

You'll be able to obtain historical Commander Harold Farncomb with 6 skill points, the Commonwealth Team commemorative flag, the Indian Tiger permanent camouflage for Delhi, and Commonwealth Tokens in the first progression line, as well as other valuable rewards for free. After completing the initial 20 levels, you'll receive 2x More Signals containers as a reward for completing each extra level.

The second progression line, unlockable for Doubloons, holds Mysore as the most prized reward. Among the other rewards, you'll be able to obtain permanent camouflages like Gregale, Canada Day, Indian Tricolor, and Blue Lagoon, as well as Commonwealth Tokens and other valuable items. After completing the initial 20 levels, you'll earn Commonwealth Tokens as rewards for completing extra levels.

Submarine Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f55c7f3d8a87fc41a3a5f24b0616e0f62fa43713.png

Multiple new features and improvements for submarines are going to be implemented with Update 13.2. This will affect not only their gameplay but also upgrades and balance.

Upon the release of Update 13.2, all players will be granted a 100% discount on demounting upgrades during the following week. The affected upgrades that are mounted on submarines at the moment of the update release will be demounted at no cost and removed from players' accounts. Compensation will be issued according to their full prices.

More information about these changes, as well as the compensation rules, will be available in a separate article.

U.S. Aircraft Carriers Leave Early Access
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/12872366b0a8c069f577ff1a1a763e8cdf7e5f56.png

Early Access to Independence, Yorktown, and Essex ends with the release of Update 13.2.

The new aircraft carriers only have access to one standard torpedo bomber squadron, which is supplemented with two tactical squadrons consisting of attack and dive bomber aircraft.

Starting from Tier VIII, the tactical squadrons are equipped with the new Smoke Curtain Generator consumable.

More information will be available in a separate article.

Ranked Battles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d9dbc28534215eeb219ccec155f735734980e913.png

Update 13.2 brings Ranked Battles Season 16.

Bronze League battles will utilize a 6 vs. 6 format with Tier VIII ships; players will helm Tier X ships and superships in both the Silver and Gold Leagues.

For the Bronze and Silver Leagues, no more than one submarine, four battleships, and four destroyers are allowed per team; for the Gold League—no more than one submarine, three battleships, and four destroyers per team.

More information will be available in the game client.

Brawls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d534d40f1d970887b4cdd30d5acc4963d747330a.png

Update 13.2 will see four Brawls unleashed in different formats. The first Brawl will utilize a 5 vs. 5 format with Tier VIII battleships, aircraft carriers, and submarines. No more than one submarine, one aircraft carrier, and four battleships per team are allowed. Players can participate in Divisions of up to three players.

More information will be available in the game client.

YouTube Memberships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/721a0ff89dc8e9c3f3fdb5db2673bfe97043f5dc.png

We've updated the benefits of our YouTube memberships program. Complete special combat missions in Update 13.2 to earn Community Tokens, Special Bonuses containers, and German Squadron containers!

The special combat missions for our YouTube members can be claimed until the end of the current update, and you have until the end of the next update to complete them.

Interface Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6f3f673ec098415cbea5d64a39fed5460f9f62f8.png

We've improved the Clan interface by including two additional windows: the first one displays information about Clan bonuses, and the second window displays the Clan description and additional information. We've also added the ability to include a clickable Discord link in the Clan description.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.2
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.2. For more information about the upcoming features and rewards for participating in the Public Test, visit the dedicated article on our website.

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/style]

April Fools' Day Event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b5274c9daa51da2519ab548a2e0bb924a53b97e5.jpg
We've created a brand-new battle type and special map for Update 13.2. Piñata Hunt pits two teams of seven Tier VIII–IX ships against one another while also tasking them to compete in sinking a special Piñata ship.

Sinking the Piñata will spawn a control point that shrinks over time for the two teams to compete over.

Upon entering battle, one of 14 event-themed camouflages will be randomly applied to your ship. A brand-new custom explosion animation will play for any ships that get sunk during the hunt.

We're also introducing a new feature—support consumables—for this game mode; they will aid you and your team in sinking the Piñata ship. Each ship can pick one consumable to take into battle, and it can be recharged for everyone on your team up to three times during each battle by entering three interactive zones that will spawn as the Piñata takes damage.

By participating in the event, you can obtain Piñata Tokens that are redeemable for candy-themed permanent camouflages.

Submarine Changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c2ed3d4ee485b36df1f4f20b50d135895c822fbd.png

We're introducing more changes in Update 13.2 to further combat "shotgunning" by submarines while maintaining the same level of effectiveness for the class. Submarine torpedoes are also being adjusted to deal different amounts of damage based on the distance from the launch point to their target.

Early Access to Commonwealth Cruisers

Update 13.2 welcomes a new line of Commonwealth cruisers and their entirely new Tech Tree to Early Access. These are the new ships: Sutlej, Port Jackson, Caradoc, Dunedin, Delhi, Hobart, Uganda, Auckland, Encounter, and Cerberus.

These ships deal decent damage per minute, but their drawbacks include relatively poor ballistics and slow-traversing turrets. At Tier VII, their torpedoes become long range to the extent that they can even be launched from stealth.

Ships of the line feature Hydroacoustic Search, available in its own slot at Tier IV and sharing a slot with Defensive AA Fire at later tiers. Starting from Tier V, they gain access to the signature Commonwealth Crawling Smoke Generator, and from Tier VIII, they have Repair Party.

Starting from Tier V, Commonwealth cruisers also have access to an enhanced variant of the Submarine Surveillance consumable with an improved range, and their Depth Charge Airstrike characteristics also improve.

Other Changes and Additions


Clan interface improvements: We've improved the Clan interface by including two additional windows: one displaying Clan bonuses and the other displaying the Clan description and info. We've also added the ability to include a clickable Discord link in the Clan description.
Commonwealth Commanders: New portraits and voiceovers for standard Commonwealth Commanders are being added to reflect India, New Zealand, Australia, and Canada.

notes.title: Update 13.1: Lunar New Year
notes.notes:
Changes to submarines and ASW, Lunar New Year celebrations, exterior system update, collaborations with popular YouTubers, the return of Airship Escort, and more!
This is a short overview of Update 13.1. You'll find more information in dedicated articles on our website.
EU NA ASIA
Submarine and ASW Updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c2ed3d4ee485b36df1f4f20b50d135895c822fbd.png
As we announced previously, we're working on solving major problems with submarine interactions, and we're now ready to present some changes to submarines and ASW. With these changes, we're aiming to create more consistent interactions between submarines and surface ships while still maintaining the current level of combat effectiveness of submarines.
Changes to the Exterior System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bccd557feb1628dc47cd446cda21166645dce5db.png
Starting with Update 13.1, most expendable camouflages available in the game will get their permanent versions. New permanent camouflages will operate similarly to already existing permanent camouflages, such as New Year, Epoch, or Made of Steel; however, you'll be able to mount them on ships of any tier. These camouflages can either be purchased or earned through various activities, events, and missions.
Lunar New Year
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ee9c2bbe8b786c64ab9c50170e851f3fbc2bc3a.png
Participate in our themed Event Pass for the occasion and journey through two progression lines that offer a plethora of rewards! Each line comprises a total of 20 levels – complete them to earn all the main rewards and gain access to additional rewards by completing extra levels.
As part of the Lunar New Year celebrations, the New Year Beast patch, Lunar Demon permanent camouflage for Hsienyang, and Commander Nian with an individual voiceover have been added to the game. The Dragon Port has also been updated for the occasion.
Airship Escort
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b42cbbe33da9a37eac25a6cabfc9d46de62c5720.png
Airship Escort returns as a separate temporary game type in the third week of Update 13.1!
As always, your goal is to help the allied airship to reach its destination while protecting it from opponents. Alternatively, you can achieve victory by destroying all enemy ships.
Format

12 vs. 12
Tier VIII–X ships
All ship types

Early Access to U.S. Aircraft Carriers Continues
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ebdae273f8e8ae717a23c5d1e0fd6c502b0955f5.png
Early Access to the new U.S. aircraft carrier line is ongoing! You can still earn American Tokens from random bundles available for Doubloons and then exchange them for rewards in the Armory: Essex with a 10-skill-points Commander and Port slot, the Hero of Midway permanent camouflage for Yorktown, the Defender of the Pacific Ocean permanent camouflage for Essex, up to 10x Wings of Freedom Premium containers, and Credits.
With the release of Update 13.2, this branch will become available for all players in the Tech Tree.
Clan Battles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/110858f649cc2682d28c5d041f553f5efa5564a9.png
A week after Update 13.1 is out, Clan Battles Season 24—dubbed "Sea Dragon"—commences.
Clan Battles offer an excellent opportunity to show off your skills in World of Warships. It's not only the results of individual battles that are important here but also general progress. Fight alongside your allies and rise to the top!
Win Clan Battles to earn valuable rewards, such as Steel, Oil, days of Warships Premium Account, and combat signals, as well as rare and unique expendable economic bonuses. The more victories you achieve, the more rewards you'll earn!
Armory
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3f6b16c708adf398cda749ad24e88aab26ef1c3c.png
Sicilia in the Research Bureau
Welcome a new addition to the Armory: with the release of Update 13.1, Sicilia will become available to purchase for 60,000 Research Points.
Battleship Sicilia takes her name from the famous island in southern Italy, as well as the swift and mighty ironclad of the same name which served in the Regia Marina at the turn of the 19th and 20th centuries.
Battle of the Java Sea
An event dedicated to the Battle of the Java Sea, one of the famous naval battles of the Pacific campaign of World War II, starts in the second week of Update 13.1.
We've prepared a special mission chain that can bring you various rewards, including Java Sea Tokens; one of two new historical Commanders, Takeo Kurita or Karel Doorman; Battle of the Java Sea containers; and a Battle of the Java Sea Premium container. Java Sea Tokens will also be available in special bundles in the Armory for Doubloons.
The Creatorverse! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9ecc8a4ea15f030c058a4a8e1ec6ea73c288d773.png
We've partnered with five major content creators to bring their unique content to World of Warships! CouRageJD, MoistCr1TiKaL, Ludwig, Nadeshot, and Sapnap are preparing to sail out on our virtual seas. Their respective Commanders—CouRage, CHUCK BLAST, Stonebeard, Nadeshot, and Sapnap—are voiced by the famous YouTubers themselves!
But that's not all: we've also prepared thematic commemorative flags representing each of them, as well as permanent camouflages carefully crafted with their input—Pride of the CouRageous for Leander, BLAST MASTER for Bayern, Stonewash for Normandie, Thief's Future for Pensacola, and Fire Carrier for Fubuki.
YouTube Memberships
We've updated the benefits of our YouTube membership program. Complete special combat missions in Update 13.1 to earn Community Tokens, along with Journey to the West containers and Lunar New Year containers!
We're expanding this program to the channels of our contributors so that more Captains can support the content they like. This means that, in addition to the three levels of membership on our official channel, you can now purchase the WoWS Commander membership level from our contributors. Check all the details here.

notes.title: Update 13.0: New U.S. Aircraft Carriers
notes.notes:
This is a short overview of Update 13.0. You can find more information in dedicated articles on our website.
EU NA ASIA
Early Access to U.S. Aircraft Carriers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8d4dae8bb57570d7d8781a0e7a13c4f60e6c2d9b.png
Early Access to the upcoming U.S. aircraft carrier line begins in Update 13.0. The three ships being added are Independence, Yorktown, and Essex. In addition to these three historical vessels, camouflages for Yorktown and Essex, as well as a commemorative flag, are being added to mark the event.
U.S. Aircraft Carriers Event Pass
Update 13.0 delivers an event comprising 20 levels that you can progress through by completing a series of daily and weekly missions. Tier VI aircraft carrier Independence stands as the most prized reward in the first progression line.
During this event, you'll have the option to unlock the second progression line for Doubloons. Much like the first progression line, this line also comprises a total of 20 levels, but where it stands out is in the rewards if offers: Tier VIII aircraft carrier Yorktown, a bonus package for Yorktown, Commander Statue of Liberty with 6 skill points and an individual voiceover, the Freedom permanent camouflage for Tier X Des Moines, and more!
American Tokens
You can exchange your American Tokens for Essex with a 10-skill-point Commander and Port slot, permanent camouflages for Yorktown and Essex, Wings of Freedom Premium containers, and Credits. Obtain them either via random bundles for Doubloons or by completing extra levels of the second progression line of the U.S. Aircraft Carriers Event Pass.
Besides American Tokens, the random bundles also hold special and rare economic bonuses of all types, Coal, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, Credits, and American battleship Rhode Island, which can only be obtained via this route. The option to purchase the new battleship will become available in a future updates.
Sestri-Ponente Dockyard Continues
The construction of cruiser Michelangelo continues at the Sestri Ponente Dockyard in Update 13.0.
During the first 3 weeks of the new update, players will be able to complete combat missions and advance through Dockyard construction phases to obtain the main reward—Michelangelo herself.

The construction process comprises 32 phases, 27 of which can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat mission groups.
You can also complete shipbuilding phases by spending 1,750 Doubloons per phase and purchasing Starter Packs: 10 shipbuilding phases in exchange for 10,000 Doubloons and 5 shipbuilding phases in exchange for 6,000 Doubloons.

The Dockyard will remain in your Port until the release of Update 13.1.
Bounty Hunt Event
Update 13.0 also includes a new iteration of the Bounty Hunt event together with changes that were previously announced in Update 12.8. The Bounty Hunt event will be available in Random Battles, and when taking on the Bounty role, players need to helm Tier VI–X battleships, cruisers, or destroyers in battle.
Both players with Bounty role and regular players will be able to earn Star Tokens, which they will be able to spend in the Star Emissaries Armory category. The main rewards are Bionic permanent camouflages for Des Moines, Buffalo, and Baltimore. Players will also be able to obtain Coal, common bonuses containers, and signals.
Star Emissaries
Besides the previously mentioned Bounty event and rewards, more goods can be found in the Star Emissaries Armory category!
As part of the event, you can use Doubloons to buy random bundles that hold STAR Kitakaze, STAR Edinburgh, Commanders Andromeda and Triangulum with 10 skill points and individual voiceovers, expendable economic bonuses, and other valuable rewards. 
The main feature of these ships is their permanent camouflages, which dynamically change their appearance in the midst of battle depending on whether the ship is detected.

Ship Parameters Display in Battle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2f273d5a582cdd857fb39c439f5bd36e4cd7396b.png
We've added a feature that enables players to see various ship parameters while in battle! Essentially, players will be able to click on opposing and allied ships in the Team window before or during a battle (press/hold the Tab key to access this window). A tooltip will appear providing information on the selected ship, such as hit points, armament ranges, movement speed, and possible consumables, among other parameters.
This feature also allows players to hover their mouse over attributes such as shells, torpedoes, and consumables in-battle and check the data for those items, similar to the functionality in Port.

Armory
With the release of Update 13.0, Halford will become available in the Armory for 228,000 Coal.
Halford is the first hybrid destroyer in our game, and the ship carries an attack aircraft tactical squadron equipped with the Engine Cooling consumable. The aircraft are armed with powerful Tiny Tim rockets with high damage and armor penetration characteristics. 
Unique Upgrades
In Update 13.0, two ships will receive new unique upgrades: German Tier X destroyer Elbing and Dutch Tier X cruiser Gouden Leeuw are each getting a unique upgrade that can be mounted in Modification Slot 6.

Hololive Collaboration
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f734e2bb7971dea3a6f4ab9b179560bc094265f4.png
Update 13.0 brings back the heroes of hololive production. Popular Japanese VTubers are ready to fill the ranks of Commanders and plunge into the heat of naval battles back-to-back with players! Welcome back the hololive commanders with individual voiceovers! Players can also obtain hololive production expendable camouflages and a memorable flag during the event.

But that's not all! Players can also complete combat missions to choose between Commander Fubuki Shirakami, with six skill points trained for I Hashidate
, or Commander Moona Hoshinova, with six skill points trained for I Chengan
as the final reward.

Ⓒ 2016 COVER Corp.
Ranked battles and Brawls
Update 13.0 delivers Ranked Battles Season 15 and unleashes three Brawls in different formats.
For a complete list of changes, please refer to Player Support

notes.title: Update 12.11: Holiday Season
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4b77f8daf6c3f769bfa848f1e550f34cb0b6512d.jpg
EU NA ASIA

Daily Login Rewards
As part of the festive events and celebrations, the daily login rewards have been updated with some extras such as an additional Superсontainer and multiple Santa’s Gift containers.


On top of this, you'll be able to find many more presents in the game and on our official platforms during this time!

Battle Performance Bonuses
Battle performance bonuses during the festive season have become a well-loved tradition, so we're happy to bring them back. Please note: We have slightly changed the rewards from last year, and they now scale better with the ship tier.


Festive Certificates are a temporary resource that can be exchanged for in-game items in Update 12.11.


Changes to Santa's Containers
Santa’s containers have mostly stayed the same but with an improvement that we hope you'll enjoy. This year, we've updated and shortened the drop list of ships: 43 older ships have been removed and 19 new ones have been added to make it easier for you to obtain more desirable ships. With these changes, there are now exactly 150 available ships in Santa's containers. All removed ships are available in the Armory for direct purchase.

The visual appearance of the containers has been updated for the occasion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/12f1ab483f7ea105f4bfe70d179d812a132f8e10.png

Holidays in Santa City
We're happy to unveil our new event that will shower you with loads of festive rewards!

Holidays in Santa City includes 20 levels, with additional rewards available after finishing them. You can advance through the levels by completing daily and weekly missions, and since they are based on scoring Base XP in any battle type, you can play the game in the way you want and still claim the rewards!

The main reward of the base progression line is new Scharnhorst '43 at level 10. We wanted to make this ship easily obtainable for all types of players, be they hardcore or casual: just fight 1–3 battles per day and you'll be able to get this ship within 5 days.


You can also unlock an additional progression line using Doubloons to earn more rewards and new Stord ’43 as the final reward.


One Festive Certificate is the reward for completing each additional level for both the first and second progress lines.
For this occasion, the Fjords Port has been transformed into Santa City.

Salvage for Victory
Salvage for Victory is back! The event comprises 100 stages, and you'll be able to unlock several new cruisers and legendary Kitakami consecutively by combining various resources. You can mix and match Research Points, Steel, and Coal without any limitations, as well as use Warships Premium Account to complete up to 16 stages of this event at any point!


Truly avid collectors can complete an extra 20 stages, and at Stage 100, you'll receive the exclusive Bitter Wind permanent camouflage for Kitakami and commemorative flags for all four ships.

Kitakami won't be distributed in any other way for the next 2 years in-game after the end of this event. The permanent camouflage for Kitakami will remain exclusive and only be available through this event. The other ships won't be distributed in any other way for at least a year.

Sestri Ponente Dockyard
Update 12.11 delivers a new Dockyard! Progress through the stages to earn various rewards and obtain the main reward—cruiser Michelangelo.

 The construction process comprises 32 Phases, and you can advance through 27 of them by completing Dockyard combat mission groups.
 You can also complete shipbuilding phases by spending 1,750 Doubloons per phase and purchasing Starter Packs: 10 shipbuilding phases in exchange for 10,000 Doubloons and five shipbuilding phases in exchange for 6,000 Doubloons.

Additionally, this iteration of the Dockyard delivers a new feature that allows you to preview Dockyard ships much like how you can preview them in the Armory.

Other

 Japanese battleships Yumihari, Adatara, and Bungo leave Early Access and will become researchable ships in the Tech Tree.
 Asymmetric Battles are still available.
 Ruggiero di Lauria will be available in Armory for 31,000 Steel.
 Piemonte will be available in the Tech Tree as a continuation of the Venezia line.

notes.notes:

IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics won’t necessarily be relevant after the update is released.

Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.

Asymmetric Battles Return
The forthcoming Update 12.10 reintroduces Asymmetric Battles in a fresh format. Battles will now be staged in a 5 vs. 12 format, featuring Tier VI–X ships and superships. While players can helm any ship types they like, submarines will be absent from the bot-controlled team.

In player teams, the maximum tier difference between ships will be limited to one; bot ships may be up to two tiers lower than player ships.

Example: Players helming Tier VI and VII ships will be pitted against bots sailing Tier IV and V ships.

Players may assemble Divisions comprising up to five members to participate in Asymmetric Battles. A single Division may include:
One aircraft carrier
Up to two battleships
Up to two cruisers
Up to two destroyers
One submarine
AI-controlled ships have been reprogrammed to prioritize attacking the player-controlled ship with the highest HP in close proximity. We’ve also slightly reduced the bots' ability to evade torpedoes. These bots will also exhibit increased engagement in battles for Key Areas.

We've implemented these changes based on our analysis and player feedback, with the aim being to enhance the gameplay experience for non-battleship classes. This also adds more dynamism and challenge to battles involving Key Areas.

Commander Skill Update
In Update 12.10, various Commander skills for battleships, cruisers, and destroyers are undergoing modification. These changes are founded on extensive statistical analysis and player feedback, with the aim being to update underused or underperforming skills. A comprehensive list of changes can be found in our DevBlog.

Players will be offered a 1-week window to reset their Commander skills at no cost following the launch of Update 12.10. Further details will be released in due course.

Halloween

You can take part in the Last Chapter Operation and finally bring to an end the conflict between the Forces of Light and the Twilight fleet. This time, you need to escort Transylvania and protect her from enemy forces as she travels on her way to deliver a special explosive to destroy the Portal once and for all!

You can participate in Last Chapter playing your own Tier VIII–IX ships of all types. Their appearance will be changed with a themed black-and-gold camouflage with special visual effects. All ships will receive special modifiers to even out their performance in the Operation.

Additionally, your team's ships will receive extra buffs each time one of your teammates' ships is destroyed, giving you a chance to complete the operation even if your team suffers multiple ship losses.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b15543d8-56cd-11ee-a4ae-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b1399fe8-56cd-11ee-89bd-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2c39cd96-56d1-11ee-89bd-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
As in previous Halloween events, the map is covered in Filth, and it gradually damages ships if they linger too long in it. Transylvania is surrounded by a safe zone that moves with the ship; however, her magic weakens over the course of the battle, causing the safe zone to become smaller until it reaches its minimum size.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdf5b65e-56cc-11ee-a522-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdf9822a-56cc-11ee-adfe-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdf6c062-56cc-11ee-a926-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdf8df00-56cc-11ee-96d3-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Japanese Battleships in Early Access
In Update 12.9 three new Japanese battleships—
, , and —will enter Early Access. To celebrate the occasion, Port Kure has been decorated.  https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f600796-56ce-11ee-a7b2-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
During the Early Access period, Personal Challenges will again become available to all players.

The new Japanese battleships won't be available on the Public Test server.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5e181aac-56cc-11ee-adfe-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5e222b82-56cc-11ee-96d3-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5e267994-56cc-11ee-a7b2-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5e25ab68-56cc-11ee-850d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Salvage for Victory
During the event, you can use a combination of multiple in-game currencies to exchange them for points and fill a progress bar. Once you reach certain milestones, you can claim corresponding rewards. Some currencies may have limitations on the number of Points you can receive. Fill up the bar to 100% to receive the final reward!

Events
Let's take a brief look at some of the upcoming events of Update 12.9. Full details will be published later in dedicated articles on our website.

Road to New Year
We're starting the New Year celebrations early! Complete special mission chains to earn Arctic Tokens that can be used to purchase containers in the Armory—the container selection refreshes with each new update. Additionally, you will receive mystery rewards for completing some of these chains—more information about them will be revealed in the future.

The final reward for the event will become available in Update 12.11: you will obtain  for completing the final mission chain.  https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/295e85e8-56cd-11ee-96d7-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
Black Friday 2023
It's "Black in Black" time! Black B and other five new ships—Smolensk B, Iwami B, Lazo B, Brandenburg B, and Repulse B—are ready to join your fleet, so you can roam the seas in style.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8a41654-56cb-11ee-96d3-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8c41594-56cb-11ee-a7b2-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8bb0c1a-56cb-11ee-850d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8bd2342-56cb-11ee-8320-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8bc3266-56cb-11ee-a4ae-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e8c4509a-56cb-11ee-8cc4-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Heroes of Might and Magic III
The astrologers proclaim the week of Heroes of Might and Magic III in World of Warships!
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/82a7fe64-56ef-11ee-96a2-ac162d70f4e4.jpg
Meet six epic new Commanders with individual voiceovers based on iconic heroes from the classic turn-based strategy game! Catherine Ironfist of the Castle, Mephala of the Rampart, Solmyr of the Tower, Sandro of the Necropolis, Nymus of the Inferno, and Gunnar of the Dungeon are ready to stand at the helms of your ships and lead their factions to victory! For this special crossover event, we've also added Heroes of Might & Magic’s iconic Kingdom of Erathia Griffin banner as a commemorative flag!

Look out for more details in a separate article on our website!

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 12.8
notes.notes:
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a1861e10-cd33-11ed-8781-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics won’t necessarily be relevant after the update is released.

Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.

[table][tr][th]World of Warships Anniversary
Airship Escort in Random Battles
Spanish Cruisers
Improvements[/th][/tr][/table]
World of Warships Anniversary
World of Warships is celebrating another glorious Anniversary—the new update marks the game’s 8th Birthday! We’ve prepared various activities and rewards in honor of the event, and the Designer's Table Port is getting freshly decorated for the occasion.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f39bc50-40b4-11ee-9f46-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f39f86e-40b4-11ee-abe0-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f3b4b42-40b4-11ee-bf58-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f399ed2-40b4-11ee-a5a9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7f3af502-40b4-11ee-8734-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Festive Rewards
To celebrate the 8th Anniversary of World of Warships, we're bringing back bonuses for your performance in battles playing all ships of Tier V and above. However, the reward distribution method has been changed, and players will earn Festive Tokens. More information about Anniversary changes can be found here.

This year, we want to renew our approach to the event and update the rewards, as well as the ways in which you can earn them.

In the past, the event structure was completely tied to the number of Tier X ships players had in Port. However, as the game progressed, more opportunities to obtain Tier X ships appeared, therefore we decided to shift the focus toward a different reward distribution and different tiers. Now, players will be able to obtain the following rewards on the Live Server: Supercontainers,
(or another Tier VIII ship if a player already has Bayard), rare economic bonuses, a new container with bonus packages and festive camouflages, as well as a special coupon for the Armory.



Airship Escort in Random Battles
After having appeared twice on the Live Server as a separate battle type (most recently, 12.0), Airship Escort is by now a familiar game mode for many players.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5ae43542-40b4-11ee-a5a9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
Airship Escort was well received by our community; however, there were some concerns over its implementation into Random Battles—we have heard the community feedback and will actively monitor its introduction. If necessary, we’ll be able to reduce the frequency of the Airship Escort game mode in Random Battles, as well as reduce the number of maps for which this mode can appear. Our goal is to add greater variety to Random Battles without adding long queue times for an additional game mode, and we’ll reevaluate this over time as we actively curate our Random Battle playlists.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a0085be0-40b3-11ee-a5a9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
As a result, Airship Escort will be resurfacing for the Public Test of Update 12.8 as one of the possible game modes in Random Battles. During the Public Test, there will be a higher chance for the Airship Escort mode to appear in Random Battles.

Spanish Cruisers
Update 12.8 marks the end of Early Access to Spanish cruisers; they will soon become researchable ships in their respective Tech Tree.

These ships have main battery guns with average range and damage per minute, and they are also armed with short-range torpedoes.

Spanish cruisers of Tier VII and higher feature the "Burst Fire" alternative firing mode, their shells follow a flatter trajectory, and their AP shells penetrate armor more effectively. These ships are fast, but they have average maneuverability.

All players will be able to try the Spanish cruisers in the upcoming Public Test.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a0005d14-40b3-11ee-9087-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
Improvements
Signals
Starting with Update 12.8, players will be able to auto-buy signals individually in the equipment window of the Port. The auto-buy feature is turned off by default, but it’s simple to switch on. Once players run out of signals, they will be able to replenish them by using Credits.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3b69b3ea-40b4-11ee-a5a9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
Notification Improvements
The appearance of the following windows has been changed: personal offers, Division invitations, Clan invitations, Training Room invitations, and behavior warnings.

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 12.7
notes.notes:
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a1861e10-cd33-11ed-8781-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics won’t necessarily be relevant after the update is released.
Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.

How do I access the Public test?

Click here to join the Public Test!

Lüshun in the Dockyard 
The construction of https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_fae90b7297e33378dbd81d57f61baa5671f67f363435768f1c9f66b39168730b.png https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Lüshun is commencing at the Tan Yun Dockyard.
 
The process comprises 35 shipbuilding phases, 30 of which can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat mission groups. You can also progress through shipbuilding phases by spending 1,950 Doubloons per phase and purchasing Starter Packs: 10 shipbuilding phases in exchange for 11,000 Doubloons and 5 shipbuilding phases in exchange for 7,000 Doubloons.
 
The Dockyard combat missions can be completed during a period that spans Update 12.7; Update 12.8; and the first 3 weeks of Update 12.9. The Dockyard will remain in your Port until the release of Update 12.10.
  https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7cbe09d0-2b84-11ee-9708-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg 
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fbc613e8-2bb2-11ee-ac1b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fbc31274-2bb2-11ee-b6d9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fc9ba5ee-2bb2-11ee-b16d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand]  
Concealed Maneuvers 
Update 12.7 features the second stage of the Concealed Maneuvers temporary battle type. We're continuing to test new mechanics for aircraft carriers—specifically, the Air-Dropped Minefield and Smoke Curtain Generator consumables. Battles will utilize a 9 vs. 9 format with Tier IX–X ships.
 
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314e27aa-2b84-11ee-97d8-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314ba3ae-2b84-11ee-ad3b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314a1ac0-2b84-11ee-9708-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand] 
For the new iteration, we're adding aircraft carriers https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_a608afcc194232095536ebc93508eb7b4b68cf46bc3600cd28b4afd0ad9a38b3.png https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.pngX Essex and https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_afff8f2e1e23cdf6b9314f80cca4fb85af40cfbe7812a9ccc707fd24ed207557.png https://wows-gloss-icons.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.pngX Taihō. Essex's bombers will be able to call in a special airstrike to deploy an Air-Dropped Minefield, while Taihō's attack aircraft will be able to deploy smoke screens. We've discussed these mechanics in greater detail here.
 
Unlike the first iteration of Concealed Maneuvers, this iteration allows you to take submarines into battle. They can interact with minefields. Each mine will have a mooring cable attached to it. If a submarine contacts the cable, the mine will detonate and damage the submarine. The closer the mine is to the submarine, the more damage it will inflict and the higher the chances of dealing critical damage will be.
 
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7cc01d38-2b84-11ee-b658-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7cc02094-2b84-11ee-ad3b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand]  
Visual and Audio Enhancements 
We've made significant changes to the audio and visual components of the game.
 
Visuals 
In Update 12.7, high-detail textures are being added to the New York Port, as well as the New Dawn, Polar, and Islands maps. The islands on these maps will receive updated collision models. The models fully match the contours of the islands in the game, and ships will be less likely to get stuck near the islands.
 
New York 
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c33fe9e2-2b83-11ee-ba15-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3403014-2b83-11ee-ad3b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c340922a-2b83-11ee-b486-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand] 
New Dawn 
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7151c4ac-2b83-11ee-bf29-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/715426ac-2b83-11ee-9708-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/71549c68-2b83-11ee-9bd9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand] 
Polar 
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/93f9766c-2b83-11ee-9bd9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/93f9766c-2b83-11ee-bf96-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/93fcf21a-2b83-11ee-bafc-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand] 
Islands 
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e89bca62-2b83-11ee-9bd9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e89b01cc-2b83-11ee-ad3b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e89aac72-2b83-11ee-bf29-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand] 
Maps with high-detail textures will feature more birds and fish; players can even come across sharks there. We've also introduced dolphins that will occasionally follow ships when there's no active combat.
  
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/11e6f9aa-2b84-11ee-aa30-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/11e407cc-2b84-11ee-9bd9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/11e421ee-2b84-11ee-bf29-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand] 
We've updated the visual effects of water splashing on ship bows; we've added animations of sea foam sweeping across ships and drops falling from the hull and floating away in the wind; we've made sun rays look more realistic underwater and added animations for air bubbles.
  
We've improved the effects for shells, bombs, and rockets hitting ships and islands, as well as the effects of overpenetration, ricochets, and citadel hits.
   
We've animated the unfolding of antennas and funnels on a number of aircraft carriers, as well as the rotation of funnels on a few French battleships. These changes will apply only to ships that have these features incorporated into their designs. For the list of ships, please refer to our Development Blog. We've also animated the rotation of secondary gun mounts that players will be able to see during calm moments on the battlefield.
  
The game visuals will look better at low graphics quality settings. They will be practically the same as the visuals at high graphics quality settings as of 2021. We've also slightly improved the game performance at the lowest quality graphics settings.
 
Audio 
We've updated sound effects of guns firing, shells hitting ships and water, overpenetration, ricochets, and waves dashing against ship bows. The sounds of battles occurring far from players will become clearly distinguishable and accurately simulate sounds traveling over long distances.
 
The quality of all sound effects and their interactions will be improved. The sound picture will adapt to the battle conditions, prioritizing sounds of greater significance and bringing them to the foreground.
  
Other Changes and Improvements 
Distinctive Insignia Changes 
A Distinctive Insignia tab will be added. This is where you can create your personal insignia by combining different available elements—the symbol, shape, border color, background color, and texture. You'll also be able to generate a random patch from the available elements; moreover, the rendering technology will be improved—patches, including existing ones, will look more realistic.
 
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5fef881e-2ba8-11ee-bf35-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5fed3910-2ba8-11ee-8ecb-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5feedd56-2ba8-11ee-9eef-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand] 
Trade-In 
During the first 2 weeks of Update 12.7, a special tab will be added to the Armory. There, players can decommission certain Tier V–X Premium and special ships, including rare ones. By doing so, they will receive significant discounts on a number of other ships obtainable for Doubloons. Rare ships that are hard or impossible to obtain can be traded for greater discounts.
 
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fb4542b4-2bb1-11ee-9969-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5c9ed788-2bb6-11ee-a82b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5f8b701e-2bb6-11ee-8201-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/62290020-2bb6-11ee-ae88-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand] 
We'll share all details about this trade-in opportunity in the future. Right now, you can try out this feature on the Public Test server!
 
Other Changes 
We're implementing an upgrade recommendation system that will cover all ships. Just like Commander skills, the recommended upgrades will now be marked with a special icon. Players will be able to buy all the recommended upgrades and mount them in vacant slots at once with the help of a special button.
 
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1491c6a6-2ba9-11ee-b486-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1492b930-2ba9-11ee-8ecb-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand] 
We've reworked the battle type selection screen. The upper section of the screen will display the permanently available battle types, and the lower section will display the temporary and seasonal types. We've updated the existing descriptions of battle types and added some new descriptions. You can open them by pressing the "i" button. We've added tooltips that pop up on hovering over the battle type icon. They contain information about ship restrictions and the time remaining until the end of particular battle types, Sprints, or Prime Times.
  https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/148028b0-2ba9-11ee-9eef-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg 
We've implemented a new approach to how Premium and special ship features are displayed in the Equipment tab.

Early Access to Spanish Cruisers
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/eaf73342-2218-11ee-88e7-ac162d70f4e4.jpg

Update 12.6 delivers Spanish cruisers to Early Access.
These ships have main battery guns with an average range and damage per minute. They are also armed with short-range torpedoes.

Cruisers of Tier VII and higher feature the "Burst Fire" alternative firing mode, their shells follow a flatter trajectory, and their AP shells penetrate armor more effectively.

The newcomers are fast, but they have only average concealment and maneuverability.

Spanish cruisers boast a wide range of consumables to choose from:
The Hydroacoustic Search consumable is available from Tier IV; starting from Tier VI, players can choose to mount Defensive AA Fire in the same slot instead.
Starting from Tier VII, Repair Party is introduced, and players have a choice between Fighter or Spotting Aircraft in another slot.
We've updated the Ocean Port and added national emblems for Spanish ships to mark the event.

Gold and Silver Spanish Tokens will come in handy while the cruisers are in Early Access, and one way of obtaining them is via the Personal Challenges event that’s making a return in Update 12.6. Once again, you'll have to demonstrate your skill by achieving specific accomplishments while commanding ships of different nations and types.

This time, the event features an updated interface.
We've added a section with information about earned rewards to the Personal Challenges page.
A number of other visual changes and improvements have been made.  https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bdca4918-2178-11ee-bda7-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg

Battle Pass
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ea233de4-2218-11ee-8396-ac162d70f4e4.jpg

As usual, the new update delivers a fresh Battle Pass. Earn BP Points by completing daily and weekly combat missions, advance through the BP progress bar, and earn awesome rewards!

The final reward of the Free Battle Pass is 7x Rare Bonuses containers and https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/afc3876a-217f-11ee-9409-ac162d70f4e4.png100 Silver Spanish Tokens. You can exchange the latter for sequential bundles that include bonus packages applicable to Tier V–VIII Early Access ships or for Gold Spanish Tokens.

The Premium Pass delivers even more valuable items, and the final reward for completing it is https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/af8401f8-217f-11ee-a7f9-ac162d70f4e4.png500 Gold Spanish Tokens. Use them to obtain sequential bundles that hold Tier IV–VIII Spanish cruisers, permanent camouflages for Tier VIII–X ships, and other items.


We've changed the post-progression rewards for the Premium Battle Pass: after completing all of its levels, players will receive 1x Rare Bonuses container and 1,000 Coal for each additional level.

The seasonal bonuses remain the same as they were in the previous iteration—additional combat missions to earn BP points and progress through levels; a +100% bonus for the first daily victory; and a +5% bonus to Coal, Steel, and Research Point earnings.

Concealed Maneuvers
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3884ab08-222d-11ee-ba6d-ac162d70f4e4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Fri. 21 Jul. 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends: Tue. 08 Aug. 02:00 CEST (UTC+2)

Update 12.6 introduces the Concealed Maneuvers temporary battle type, which has been designed to test new mechanics for aircraft carriers.

We've added two new aircraft carriers to the game— https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.pngVIII Kikaku and https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.pngVIII Concord Bridge. They resemble  https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_9f372d47b4fa5b5bbd79a3aaac816cb8d5343fa93949cce8934d94b84751b88e.pngVIII Shōkaku and https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_9f372d47b4fa5b5bbd79a3aaac816cb8d5343fa93949cce8934d94b84751b88e.pngVIII Lexington, except that they feature adjusted parameters and squadrons with unique consumables. These aircraft carriers can be rented for the duration of the event; however, you can't take them into battles of any other type.

What sets these new aircraft carriers apart are their squadrons' unique consumables—Smoke Curtain Generator and Air-Dropped Minefield.

 https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.pngVIII Kikaku's attack aircraft are equipped with Smoke Curtain Generator, which can set smoke screens just like ships with Smoke Generators.

https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.pngVIII Concord Bridge's bombers are armed with the Air-Dropped Minefield consumable. When activated, it calls in another aircraft to deploy a minefield within a circular area below the position of the squadron at the point of activation. The mines don't arm immediately, but once they do, they deal damage to any enemy ships that collide with them, and they have high chances of causing flooding.

Format
Tier VII–VIII aircraft carriers, cruisers, battleships, and destroyers in a 9 vs. 9 format.
Eligible aircraft carriers aren’t limited to  https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.pngVIII Kikaku and https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.pngVIII Concord Bridge; all classes are allowed.

European Destroyers Are Available to Everyone
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ea88891a-2218-11ee-a9b1-ac162d70f4e4.jpg

When Update 12.6 goes live, the European destroyers will become available for all players to research.

These newcomers are artillery destroyers that primarily rely on their main battery guns in battle.
They are exclusively armed with HE shells; starting from Tier VIII, the shells have flat-trajectory ballistics.
The high-speed torpedoes of the new European destroyers should be considered as secondary armament in most situations due to their low damage and rather short range.
The highlight of this branch is the consumable combination of Smoke Generator and Surveillance Radar, the latter of which is available from Tier VIII and features a long range but a short action time. The destroyers are also equipped with Engine Boost.
The new ships have mediocre speed and poor concealment, but higher-tier representatives boast large HP pools.
Armory
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e9c37aa8-2218-11ee-bbd0-ac162d70f4e4.jpg

Ends: Fri. 01 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)

You can purchase them in limited quantities in exchange for in-game resources and in unlimited quantities for Doubloons. One Pass costs 250 Doubloons.

If you already possess every ship that can be obtained through Warship Strike, you'll be rewarded with https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/34f0cd0c-2186-11ee-a1a0-ac162d70f4e4.png1x Strike Pass.
Warship Strike can be played in the game client and on the Armory website.

Van Speijk
With the release of Update 12.6,  https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngIX Van Speijk will become available in the Armory for 46,500 Research Points.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/78c49462-2188-11ee-8871-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
In 1938, the Netherlands decided to strengthen their fleet, and new designs similar to Scharnhorst were introduced in 1939. The authorities were set on reducing the size of the ship for economic reasons. They favored a 16,000-ton cruiser with a projected speed of 33 knots and either 240 mm or 280 mm main battery guns; however, they eventually had to settle on a smaller caliber for the project.

The cruiser is armed with nine 203 mm main battery guns that don't have a particularly long range of fire. She also comes with HE Bomb Airstrike. This armament boasts an extensive action range but takes a lot of time to reload and is limited to only one flight. Other strengths of the ship include a well-armored citadel and decent concealment.

The cruiser has also access to Hydroacoustic Search, Defensive AA Fire, and Repair Party with a reduced reload time in separate slots.

Naval Community

The Symbols of Yukon bundle
The Leningrad Defense permanent camouflage for  https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngVII Leningrad

The More Camouflages container

A bundle with "The Beautiful Game" flag and patch, available for 4,000 Community Tokens

The Bionic permanent camouflage for https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngVI Pensacola, available for 4,000 Community Tokens
The Orca permanent camouflage for https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngVII Huron, available for 6,000 Community Tokens

The Independence Day permanent camouflage for https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.pngVII Colorado, available for 8,000 Community Tokens

Battle of the Somme Collection
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e9974578-2218-11ee-a9b1-ac162d70f4e4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts: Thu. 27 Jul. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends: Thu. 24 Aug. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)

A week after the release of Update 12.6, a new collection—Battle of the Somme—will become available. It commemorates one of the most immense battles of World War I, which took place from July 1, 1916 through November 18 of the same year on both banks of the River Somme. It was a confrontation between the armies of the British Empire and French Third Republic on one side and the forces of the German Empire on the other side.

To complete this collection, you'll need 60 different elements that the new Battle of the Somme containers can drop. These containers can be obtained in the Armory in exchange for Doubloons and in the Premium Shop. They are also rewarded for completing combat missions, and the number of containers you can earn this way will be sufficient to complete the entire collection. The exchange rate for duplicate elements is 2:1.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/392b56aa-2189-11ee-a7fb-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
We'll reveal the contents of this container on our website with the release of Update 12.6.

The rewards for completing the collection are https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX Somme, a ship that's kin to https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngIX Jutland, with the unique "Lest We Forget" permanent camouflage and a Commander with 10 skill points.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/392f2744-2189-11ee-b382-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
Economic Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e9ab6e04-2218-11ee-9cc3-ac162d70f4e4.jpg

Starting with Update 12.6, we'll be adding Operations to the majority of combat missions. Due to the specifics of this battle type, it's easier to fulfil the requirements of some combat missions in Operations; so as not to change the difficulty of missions in other battle types, results achieved in Operations will be reduced by a certain factor.

For certain metrics, the progress in combat missions and Personal Challenges will be halved when playing in Operations. For example, if a mission requires you to earn two "Destroyed" ribbons, you’ll need to earn four such ribbons if you decide to go for it in Operations. Another way to complete this mission would be by earning one ribbon in a Random Battle and two ribbons in Operations.

When the reduction factor is applied to combat missions, the Operations icon will display a special indication.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/430f31fa-2215-11ee-85d7-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
Brawls
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ea413f24-2218-11ee-9275-ac162d70f4e4.jpg

Update 12.6 features four Brawls in different formats.

Brawl 1
[expand type=details]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Start: Fri. 21 Jul. 10:00 CEST (UTC+2)

Format: 5 vs. 5 playing Tier IX ships; no more than two battleships and three destroyers. You can participate in a Division of up to five players.
[/expand]
Brawl 2
[expand type=details]
Format: 4 vs. 4 playing Tier VIII submarines, destroyers, cruisers, and battleships; no more than one submarine, two battleships, and two destroyers. You can participate in a Division of up to four players.
[/expand]
Brawl 3
[expand type=details]
Format: 4 vs. 4 playing Tier X battleships. You can participate in a Division of up to two players.
[/expand]
Brawl 4
[expand type=details]
Format: 3 vs. 3 playing Tier X ships; no more than one submarine, one aircraft carrier, two destroyers, two cruisers, and two battleships. You can participate in a Division of up to three players.
[/expand]

Division Star
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/385e91e8-222d-11ee-aee2-ac162d70f4e4.jpg

The Division Star is a special event in which you can earn extra rewards by playing together with your Clanmates.
You can earn a Division Star by playing in a Division with your Clanmates.
Stars can be earned in all battle types, except for Training Battles.
Certain numbers of earned Stars unlock access to various rewards.
If you switch Clans, any Stars and rewards you previously received remain with you.

By playing together with your Clanmates, you can earn a total of up to three Stars—one for each fulfilled requirement:
Winning a battle.
Earning the "Shoulder to Shoulder" Division achievement.
Earning the "Coordinated Attack" Division achievement.  https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42e1eb3c-2215-11ee-bbd0-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
Technical Improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/eabdf00a-2218-11ee-a48d-ac162d70f4e4.jpg

Settings Menu Improvements
In Update 12.6, we've completely reworked the Settings menu interface.

All available parameters are now divided into eight sections: Display, Graphics, Audio, HUD, Camera, Mouse, Keyboard/Controls, and Other. Certain settings have been removed, while others have been merged together.

The interface changes introduced in this update aim to enhance user experience by providing a simpler and more convenient way to personalize the game to your liking! Furthermore, "under the hood" enhancements have been implemented so that we can seamlessly add new settings in the future.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9132b392-2216-11ee-939c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg
Recruiting Station Combat Missions
Update 12.6 delivers missions with requirements specifically designed for Recruiters and their Shipmates. Team up in Divisions to progress through them and earn rewards!

Only Division members who are in a "Recruiter-Shipmate" relationship with at least one other Division mate will have their progress towards the Recruiting Station combat missions counted.

Replay Improvements
We've added the post-battle statistics screen to the end of replays.
We've also added a "Watch Again" button.
Twitch Drops
Twitch Drops are back in Update 12.6. We took advantage of this break to make a technical improvement that will allow users to request and receive Twitch Drops without the need to re-log into their accounts.

Game Balance Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/380ed8a6-222d-11ee-bec1-ac162d70f4e4.jpg

We’re tuning the balance of certain ships based on our analysis of their combat effectiveness and your feedback. The changes will affect U.S. researchable hybrid battleships and British cruiser https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngV Hawkins.

Tier V British cruiser Hawkins
The shell ballistics have been changed and are now characterized by a flatter trajectory.
The armor penetration capabilities of AP shells have been improved.
Content Additions and Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ea69cb06-2218-11ee-85d7-ac162d70f4e4.jpg

In Update 12.7, Ranked and Clan Tokens will be removed from the game, and players will receive compensation in the form of Steel. As long as that Update is live, camouflages that are available in exchange for Ranked and Clan Tokens will also be available for Steel. More info on these changes will follow at a later date.

Container Changes

Other Changes and Improvements

Lantern Lights

Other Changes
The starting number of points in the updated Domination mode in Co-op Battles has been increased from 150 to 200.

Removed visual artifacts in the following Ports: Saint Petersburg, Zipangu, and Naval Base.

Fixed an issue that made it impossible to switch to the Binocular View when opening the game menu or hovering over the Minimap while pressing Shift.

Fixed an issue that caused Commander Michiel de Ruyter not to be marked as "Historical" in the Captain's Logbook.
Fixed an issue that prevented players from getting a reward for completing a global mission chain.
Fixed a bug that made it impossible to activate Combat Instructions with the Airstrike or torpedo armaments selected.
We've added tooltips to the conditions of combat missions to be completed to earn certain achievements.

notes.title: The Return of Convoy in Update 12.4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/84b92a52d456ff416beb356cde109e5cc873a291.jpg
The Convoy temporary battle type is back in the game in Update 12.4.

You're once again tasked with defending or attacking transport ships that are en route to their destination point with essential supplies.

The principles behind the Convoy battle type are based on real historical events. In the past, sea battles didn't only involve warships clashing and aerial assaults. A significant aspect of naval confrontations involved defending or attacking the shipping lanes that were being used to transport strategically important cargo.

Convoy will be available throughout Update 12.4.

[table][tr][th]What Has Changed

Rewards
Combat Missions[/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
What Has Changed
Update 12.4 delivers the following changes:
We've added one more map—you'll be fighting tooth and nail on Haven.
We've updated the behavior of bot ships—transport ships will now change their speed to avoid torpedoes instead of changing course.
We've improved the battle type interface.

Defending and attacking
[expand type=details]
Two teams participate in each battle—one is tasked with escorting cargo ships, and the other is tasked with attacking them. Players are randomly distributed between the two teams. You can enter each battle either alone or as part of a Division of up to three players.
[/expand]
Team missions
[expand type=details]
The defending team needs to escort convoys of cargo ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one convoy ship reaches her destination point or the entire enemy team is sent back to Port. The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.
[/expand]
Transport ships
[expand type=details]
All convoys are made up of Liberty-class transport ships. They have little HP and weak armor. On the other hand, they can deploy smoke screens and change speed to avoid enemy torpedoes. In addition, these ships are armed with two main battery guns and twelve secondary battery guns that are capable of firing at approaching opponents. They also have AA defenses to repel air attacks.
[/expand]
Format
12 vs. 12 with Tier VIII—X ships.
Maps
North, Hotspot, Trap, Two Brothers, Tears of the Desert, Haven, Crash Zone Alpha.

Depending on the map, the convoys can follow two or three routes at the same time, leading to one or several destinations.

Public Test 12.4 includes special missions that will bring you rewards on the Live Server.
Recurring Combat Missions
Earn 12,000 Base XP in Convoy, Random Battles, and Co-op Battles playing Tier VI–X ships and superships.

Reward on the Live Server: 1,600 Community Tokens.
[hr][/hr]
Earn 1,000 Base XP in Random and Co-op Battles.

Reward on the Live Server: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png1,000 Coal; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png2,500 Free XP; 200 Community Tokens; and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png500,000 Credits.

This combat mission will only be available on the second and third days of each round of the Public Test. The mission refreshes at 02:00 UTC.

Combat Mission Chains
First Chain
Deal damage, earn Base XP, and obtain "Destroyed" ribbons. You can find more details about the chain in the Public Test client.

Reward on the Live Server: 1x Tactical Special container and 6x Italian Cruisers containers.
You can complete the combat mission chain in Random and Co-op Battles, as well as in Convoy, playing Tier VI–X ships and superships. The chain will be available for completion throughout the entire duration of Public Test 12.4.

Second Chain
Gain victories, earn Base XP, deal damage, and obtain "Destroyed" ribbons. You can find more details about the chain in the Public Test client.

Reward on the Live Server: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png5,000 Free XP; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png700 Coal; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png800,000 Credits; and 10,000 Elite Commander XP.
You can complete the combat mission chain in Random and Ranked Battles, as well as in Convoy, playing Tier VI–X ships and superships. The chain is available for completion three times per day between the following times: 11:00–15:00 UTC; 17:00–21:00 UTC; and 22:00–02:00 UTC. You can complete all the missions three times and also obtain the rewards three times during each day of the Public Test.

You can find more details about the chains in the Public Test client.

Players who join the 12.4 Public Test Server will also receive the following rewards on the Live Server: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png250 Doubloons, 2x More Coal containers, and 1x Tactical Special container.

In total during Public Test 12.4, you can obtain up to 7,500 Community Tokens; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png25,100 Coal; 4x Tactical Special containers; 2x More Coal containers; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png450 Doubloons; 6x Italian Cruisers containers; 14x Pioneer camouflages; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png150,000 Free XP; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png24,400,000 Credits; and 280,000 Elite Commander XP. [hr][/hr]
Starting Bonuses
The research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
You'll be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.
If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 12.3 release, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
All researchable Tier VI and VIII ships with 21-skill-point Commanders
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png500,000,000 Credits; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png30,000 Doubloons; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png250,000 Coal; and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png90 days of Warships Premium Account
50 signals and sets with expendable economic bonuses
If you fought at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 12.3 Public Test, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.

Captains, thank you for participating in the first round of the Public Test for Update 12.3! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

Changelog
Fixed visual errors in the Kure Dockyard, the Seychelles map, and the Zipangu Port.
Fixed an incorrect description in the tooltip about the usage of Burst Fire at the beginning of a battle.
Fixed an issue which caused the incorrect display of the parameters of skip-bombers in the tooltips in battle.
Fixed an issue which caused the Seychelles map to fail to display the islands on the tactical map due to fog.
Fixed an issue which caused the last attack flight of https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_8f3e3f4bb152e80cc8fb2cc34d426c6d85d57b72014c768883384055a2c2f3f7.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.pngVIII Graf Zeppelin's torpedo bombers to drop two torpedoes instead of three.[hr][/hr]

Captains, thank you for participating in the first round of the Public Test for Update 12.1! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

Changelog
Balance changes applied to Unique Upgrades. Details are available in a post on the Development Blog.
The settings of the updated Domination mode have been adjusted: the starting number of points for teams is 150; the reward for destroying an enemy ship is 40 points; and the penalty for losing an allied ship is 25 points.
Fixed a bug due to which the client could crash during the start or end of a battle.
Fixed a bug with the position of the ship in the port of Fjords.

Tier VIII ships in a 1 vs. 1 format.
All ship types are available.

Tier X ships in a 3 vs. 3 format.
All ship types are available.
You can participate in a Division of up to three players.
Restrictions: No more than one aircraft carrier, one submarine, two cruisers, two destroyers, and two battleships.
