notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 12.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg
IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.

Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.

[table][tr][th]Early Access to British Submarines
Global Combat Missions
Domination With New Settings
Technical Updates[/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
Early Access to British Submarines
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/91b5417c-98a5-11ed-af9b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/91a29b62-98a5-11ed-88ef-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/91b14dec-98a5-11ed-b231-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
British submarines hit the seas in Early Access in Update 12.1. To celebrate the occasion, the Iron Resilience permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_d6308791bceab9314e41018c12d68f2f809d8f92296e77459708373cd6a94113.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Submarine/standard_261525e5aae827700eaad3b5c3ab72d1721446ecab80226394fd30e9186d8a2d.pngVIII Sturdy and the Victoria Cross permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_d6308791bceab9314e41018c12d68f2f809d8f92296e77459708373cd6a94113.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Submarine/standard_261525e5aae827700eaad3b5c3ab72d1721446ecab80226394fd30e9186d8a2d.pngX Thrasher, as well as the British Submarines commemorative flag, have been added to the game.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/36eae83a-98a7-11ed-903d-ac162d70f4e4.jpg
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cb94ff1c-98a6-11ed-b231-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cba5c57c-98a6-11ed-903d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
The British submarines will not be available on the Public Test server.
[hr][/hr]
Global Combat Missions
Global combat missions are being introduced into the game in Update 12.1. Their goal will be common to all players on the server, and each participant will contribute to the mission progress. Global combat missions can be represented both by chains and individual missions.

After completing a global combat mission, all players who participated in it will receive the final reward. It's possible to complete global combat missions before their official deadlines. If this happens, only those players who actually contributed to the mission progress will receive the reward.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55c68850-98a6-11ed-8900-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55d177b0-98a6-11ed-9a98-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55d02e82-98a6-11ed-903d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Domination With New Settings
During Public Test 12.1, you will be able to try out the modified Domination mode with three Key Areas for Random Battles. The new settings are aimed at eliminating situations where battles are too long or too short.

New Settings
Starting number of points at the beginning of battle: 200
Points when destroying an enemy ship: +40 for all ship types
Points when losing a ship: –32 for all ship types
The modified Domination mode will be added to the following maps: New Dawn, Fault Line, Shards, Trident, Neighbors, Crash Zone Alpha, Northern Waters, and Faroe Islands. We will decide on the final fate of the modified Domination based on the results of testing the new settings.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3739ce78-98a7-11ed-9911-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/376c87aa-98a7-11ed-8900-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Technical Updates
Added interactive music for submarines. It will match the special stealthy gameplay of submarines. The music will change depending on several factors:
Combat situation
Actions performed by the submarine or her opponents
Location of the submarine—on the surface or underwater

notes.title: Airship Escort in Update 12.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3dbb9f83343c92115f6ac98116a4bfb951991543.jpg
The battle type that tasks you with escorting airships returns to the game with some improvements and a new name.

Airships historically carried intelligence agents bearing important messages and diplomats traveling to conduct secret negotiations in neutral territories.

Your objectives are to delay the hostile airship while also making sure that your allied airship is the first to reach the destination point.

[table][tr][th]Rules
Rewards
Maps[/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=ELoYdW4K-i0;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
Rules https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6ea297b6-9666-11ed-a5fb-ac162d70f4e4.jpg
Restrictions
The battle type involves Tier VIII–X ships of all types fighting in teams of 12.

The Task
Lead your allied airship to its destination before the opposing team does or destroy all hostile ships.

Ships can affect the speed of the allied or opposing airships by staying within an interactive zone near each one:
Airships move at a standard speed if there are no players within its interactive zone.
Airships accelerate if only allied ships are within the borders of their interactive zones.
Airships slow down if at least one opposing ship is within the borders of their interactive zones.
If your team simultaneously speeds up the allied airship and slows down the opposing airship, the allied airship now receives additional acceleration. This change will help prevent situations that previously occurred where battles continued for too long when one of the teams was able to gain a serious lead over the opposing team. At the same time, the base airship speed has been reduced to prevent battles between equal teams from ending too quickly.

notes.title: UPDATE: The 5 USD Bounty Challenge Just Got Easier!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/19b78fa043402380837d56f9dbf379f49be0eb41.png

Happy December, Captains!

To celebrate the huge popularity of our 5th Anniversary event—and in the spirit of the holiday season—we’ve prepared a surprise update for all our new players hunting the 5 USD Steam Credit bounty.

 Now it's 5 times easier to get your free credit — you just need to get the “Amateur” achievement! This achievement is granted whenever you win your  first 10 Random Battles! 

You’ll know you’ve qualified to win when you’ve earned the “Amateur” achievement in the game client, which in total should take you no more than 3 to 4 hours of playtime.

And one last thing: to honor our most active players, we will send 1 Santa's Gift container and 1 Steam Container to all players who have earned the Warrior achievement at the event end!


Terms and conditions:

[expand type=showmore ]

If you already had the “Amateur” achievement before November 17th, you can still get 5 USD earning the “Warrior” achievement for winning 50 Random Battles.
If you didn't have the “Amateur” achievement before November 17th and earned both the “Amateur” and the “Warrior” achievements, you will get a Steam container and a Santa container as a bonus.
The achievement must be unlocked in the game client in your World of Warships account in order to be validated. This is not to be confused with the Steam Achievements.
While the achievement must be unlocked during the event’s duration, not all progress toward the achievement needs to occur in the same time frame.
The Warrior achievement can only be earned once.
The reward will be issued only once per user, no later than 1 week after the event ends.
By participating in the event, you accept the applicable Rules of the World of Warships game and Clans. All winners will be subject to anti-bot checks before prizes are distributed. Duplicate accounts will not be rewarded.
By participating in the event, you accept the "5 USD Bounty Challenge" promotion rules available below. Please note that if you win a reward, your Steam ID will be shared with Valve Corporation to enable crediting of the reward to your Steam Wallet account.


Detailed rules of the event can be found here.[/expand]


Happy anniversary, Captains!

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.9
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg
IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.
Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[table][tr][th]Early Access to U.S. and German Submarines
Personal Challenges
Operation Wolfpack
Technical Updates
Halloween
Other Changes[/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
Early Access to U.S. and German Submarines
We are pleased to introduce a new ship type—submarines! We worked hard to prepare submarines for their eventual release during their time in testing. We've tweaked their mechanics and the ways they interact with other ship types based on the test results, statistics, and player feedback.

Following the latest round of changes to this ship type, we're confident that submarines in their current state fit well into the gameplay of World of Warships and are ready to be introduced into the game on a permanent basis. U.S. and German submarines will be the first full-fledged representatives to emerge (or submerge!) in the game.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cedb1ae8-329f-11ed-9f00-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cee6857c-329f-11ed-bd80-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cedec652-329f-11ed-a759-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cee40bf8-329f-11ed-9a9a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Early Access
German and U.S. Tier VI and VIII submarines will arrive in Early Access. They can be obtained from sequential bundles in the Armory in exchange for Submarine Tokens.

The Tokens can be obtained by completing Personal Challenges that await you in Update 0.11.9; in exchange for Community Tokens; and from random bundles for Doubloons.

Submarines can also be obtained from the new Submarines containers.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/86c1cd88-32a4-11ed-aed8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
You'll be able to reset all of your Commanders' skills if you so wish and remove upgrades free of charge during the first 2 weeks after Update 0.11.9 goes live. To automatically reset skills of all your Commanders for free, you'll need to click a button in a special article on our website.
For several updates after the release of Update 0.11.9, we don't plan to make significant changes to the gameplay of submarines, their settings, and the way they interact with other ship types, unless there is a critical need to do so. This will allow them to catch on in the game and give players an opportunity to acclimatize to the new ship type. In the meantime, we'll be able to collect the most up-to-date and accurate statistics. At the same time, small balance changes will still be made when necessary.
[hr][/hr]
Personal Challenges
Personal Challenges will become available again during Update 0.11.9. For this iteration, we've updated the interface, as well as diversified the mission completion criteria.

As before, Personal Challenges are divided into two stages of 2 weeks each. During the first stage, you need to earn ribbons; during the second stage, you need to earn Base XP. In future iterations, new conditions will be added, such as damage dealt.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/97f27d52-32ac-11ed-ad45-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/96d4c038-32ac-11ed-874d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
As a reward for completing missions, you'll earn Submarine Tokens, which are required to obtain submarines in Early Access, as well as Coal. [hr][/hr]
Operation Wolfpack
Special Operation Wolfpack is dedicated to the release of submarines. It will allow players to get to grips with the new ship type and its gameplay.

The Operation is inspired by real World War II events—submarines hunting for convoys.

Rules
Players fight at the helms of Tier VI and VIII submarines in a team of seven.

An enemy convoy with strategic cargo breaks through neutral waters. A combat squadron rushes to help the convoy.

Your objective is to break through the lines of escorting warship groups and destroy the transport ships before they reach their destination point and meet with reinforcements. During the Operation, the submarine squadron will be provided with air support from allied aircraft.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3a0749a-32ac-11ed-b68b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3cb9abc-32ac-11ed-90be-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3b432d2-32ac-11ed-8fe0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Technical Updates
We've returned the movement effect of sonar pings emitted by submarines. It was good at drawing the attention of both the targeted player and their allies to the attacking submarine. Combined with the ping launch effect that appears on the surface of the water, it will allow you to locate a submarine more accurately and attack her more effectively.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6fca6dc8-32a5-11ed-aed8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Added new ribbons for depth charges. They will more clearly show the effectiveness of dropping bombs on submarines:
[table][tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/36e2dbfa-32a3-11ed-aed8-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]The "Hit" ribbon is awarded when a submarine receives full damage from a depth charge.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/37048c5a-32a3-11ed-a3f6-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]The "Splash Damage" ribbon is awarded when a submarine receives partial damage from a depth charge.[/td][/tr][/table]
Adding Automatic ASW for Aircraft Carriers
All aircraft carriers of Tier VI and above will receive a variant of Depth Charge Airstrike that functions automatically. It will not serve as a tool for hunting submarines; it will only give aircraft carriers a means of defense against submarines that deploys even when the ship's Captain is controlling squadrons.

Depth Charge Airstrike will activate if a submarine or signs of her presence, such as oil spots on the water or the effect of using sonar, are detected within the armament's range. An airstrike will be carried out taking any necessary lead into account. At the same time, the submarine will have the opportunity to evade if she effectively maneuvers in time.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c967a6fc-32a5-11ed-9729-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg [hr][/hr]
Halloween
Operations Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness await players this year as part of the Halloween celebrations.

Operation Saving Transylvania will be available as Operation of the Week in the first week of the update; Sunray in the Darkness—in the second week. Players will be able to complete them as part of a Division throughout Update 0.11.9. Both Operations will be available at the normal difficulty level. Standard Operations will be available for completion during Update 0.11.9 as part of a Division only. With the release of Update 0.11.10, Operations of the Week will be replaced by Random Operations again.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/554d8632-32a6-11ed-9729-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55526044-32a6-11ed-af91-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/94b7c224-32a6-11ed-8d29-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
The update also brings back the Twilight Battle temporary battle type, which is familiar to players from Halloween 2018, with minor visual improvements. Let's take a refresher on the key rules of this event!

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/29d3e35c-32a6-11ed-87c3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/29db1d02-32a6-11ed-bd80-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2a2b47dc-32a6-11ed-8c0b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Two teams of seven players each clash against each other playing special ships on the map from Operation Sunray in the Darkness. The key objective is to destroy all enemy ships. At the same time, the water area is gradually taken over by the Filth, and the safe zone for ships continuously shrinks. Ships outside the safe zone receive damage depending on the ship type.

Twilight Battle will become available 2 weeks after Update 0.11.9 goes live.
[hr][/hr]
Other Changes
Changes to Commanders, skills, and upgrades
A number of unique Commander talents, skills, and upgrades have been updated to bring them to a better balance and increase their versatility. More details are available on our Development Blog.

We've also made improvements to the interface of the Commander Skills screen and Skills in Detail section. It's now possible in the Reserve to view the available Commanders of all nations, regardless of whether Captains have ships of those nations or not.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6f17136-32a9-11ed-a6d6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6c6551e-32a9-11ed-b06b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6dde62a-32a9-11ed-874d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]

Commanders, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.8! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

Balance changes were applied to researchable Italian and German destroyers, as well as a number of other ships. Depth Charge Airstrike parameters have additionally been unified for all cruisers and battleships. Details are available on our Development Blog.
Updated bot Tiers and fixed a number of bugs in Operations.

Fixed a number of bugs in several different Ports.
Fixed a bug due to which ships could get stuck near the islands on some maps.

Fixed a bug due to which characters were duplicated in the game chat text entry box when opening the tactical map.

You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. These Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.8
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg
IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.

Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.

[table][tr][th]World of Warships Anniversary
Warship Strike
Reworked Operations
Changes to the Reload Mechanics[/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
World of Warships Anniversary
This year, World of Warships is celebrating its seventh birthday! We've prepared various activities for our players in honor of the occasion.

Seven Seas Collection
An important new feature that's also part of our birthday celebrations is the Seven Seas collection dedicated to historic ports that have been recreated in our game. The Seven Seas collection will let you take a fresh look at familiar locations from a new perspective and get to know some curious facts from the history of as many as 16 famous ports.

The collection elements can only be obtained from dedicated same-name containers. You can earn these containers by progressing through special chains of combat missions and also find them in free daily bundles in the Armory. Rest assured that those containers will be quite enough to complete the entire collection. The collection consists of four pages, with four elements on each.

Reward for completing a page: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Warships Premium Account.
Reward for completing the collection: bonus package for a Tier VII ship. https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d29aed54-1c90-11ed-8872-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Note: The new collection will not be available on the Public Test Server.

Festive Rewards
To celebrate the Seventh Anniversary of World of Warships, we're bringing back gift bonuses for your performance in battles playing all ships of Tier V and above. This time, however, we've added an important enhancement—the ability to receive several gifts for a single battle!

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34c44aba-1c92-11ed-8944-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34cfef3c-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35f26caa-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3640f672-1c92-11ed-ad59-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35055c94-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
If a player has 100 or more ships, they will be able to receive a standard gift for a battle played with a ship, as well as extra bonus gifts that depend on the amount of Base XP earned. The old rule that you can't get gifts a second time playing the same ship applies as well.

Extra bonus gifts can be applied toward any other ship they have not been applied to, so you can "score" a gift for that ship without the need to actually hit the seas for battle at her helm.

The bonus gift rewards depend on your ship tier:
For Tier V–VII ships, it's 1x Special Bonuses container
For Tier VIII–IX ships, it's 1x Rare Bonuses container and 1x Special Bonuses container
For Tier X ships and superships, it's 1x Supercontainer
The number of bonus gifts you receive after a battle depends on the number of ships you have in your Port and the amount of Base XP earned in that battle. For example, a player with a Port fleet exceeding 300 ships will be able to earn four gifts in one battle: one gift for entering battle with a ship and three gifts for effective action in battle.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/02f79758-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
The new Special Bonuses container drops Level 2 economic bonuses. 5x bonuses of one of the following types: "Credits +40%," "Ship XP +200%," "Commander XP +200%," "Free XP +600%."

The new Rare Bonuses container drops Level 3 economic bonuses. 3x bonuses of one of the following types: "Credits +160%," "Ship XP +800%," "Commander XP +800%," "Free XP +2,400%."
[hr][/hr]
Warship Strike
One of the fresh activities that's getting released with Update 0.11.8 involves challenging AI in a new game codenamed "Warship Strike," inspired by a classic naval combat game. You can access the game via the Armory. You'll need a special resource—a Strike Pass—to unlock access to it and play. Strike Passes can be earned by completing special combat missions.

You can pause any ongoing battle at any time and return to it later, and your progress will be saved. Battles can also be completed automatically. In that case, the AI completes the battle for you. The battle results will simply appear on the screen, and you'll receive all due rewards in the form of Festive Tokens. These are issued for sinking enemy ships and winning battles.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/64b9c772-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/649ba008-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
You can exchange these Tokens in the Armory for the option that suits your needs best:
Permanent camouflages
Bonus packages for ships
Economic bonuses
Containers with signals and resources
Credits [hr][/hr]
Reworked Operations
In Update 0.11.8, we've reworked all Operations in the game. The purpose of these changes is to give you the opportunity to participate in Operations playing more of your favorite ships and earn valuable rewards along the way.

Now, Tier VI to VIII ships can be matched in battle at the same time, and the final team lineup will have an effect on the strength of the bots and post-battle earnings. The "fee" for re-entering battle with the same ship will be removed.

The economy in effect in Operations will change as well. Previously, players earned Stars for completing an Operation, and the rewards could only be obtained once. We've removed Stars altogether, and the rewards can now be earned by progressing through dedicated daily and weekly combat missions specifically designed for Operations. The rewards are Community Tokens.

The Operation of the Week won't be available in Update 0.11.8. When playing on a team where your allies are selected automatically, an Operation will be picked at random. You will still be able to select an Operation of your liking when you are part of a Division.

Update 0.11.8 brings back the following three Operations for the revamped game mode: The Ultimate Frontier, Hermes, and Cherry Blossom.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/85ea4502-1c92-11ed-9180-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8680b76c-1c92-11ed-a853-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/867fda04-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a2490a30-1c92-11ed-8944-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a248fce8-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a24937da-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3fcba64-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3fb9e72-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3719ef2-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Changes to the Reload Mechanics
We've changed the gun reload mechanics that are applied when switching shell type.

With the "Gun Feeder" Commander skill active, the shell type will now switch faster even if not all main battery guns are completely reloaded after a salvo (which was required prior to the change for the skill to take effect).

Shells now have a new parameter—"shell-type switching time."
If the current gun reload time exceeds the shell-type switching time, shell switching will not affect the gun reload time.
If the current gun reload time is shorter than the shell-type switching time, the gun reload time when switching shell types is equal to the shell-type switching time.
The Gun Feeder skill bonus applied to shell-type switching time has been changed from –50% to –40%. For example, if the standard gun reload time is 30 seconds, the shell-type switching time with the Gun Feeder skill activated will be 18 seconds, but the following should be kept in mind:
If the remaining gun reload time is 20 seconds and you switch shell type, the reload time will still be 20 seconds.
If only 5 seconds are left for the guns to reload, switching shell type will increase the gun reload time to 18 seconds.
The new mechanics apply to each turret individually. Shell-type switching time will be shown in a ship's tech specs.
Additionally, all researchable Italian battleships will have the "–30% to shell-type switching time" bonus applied by default, which means that it will apply even when the Gun Feeder skill is inactive. Activating the skill will further increase this bonus.

Speaking of Italian battleships, switching between shell types frequently is an important gameplay component. The extra bonus will emphasize this feature and increase the effectiveness of using the Gun Feeder skill compared to battleships of other nations.

Commanders, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.7! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

Changelog
Removed settings "Fly around the ship before battle starts" and "Airstrike alternative controls".
Updated a number of UI interaction sounds and added some new ones.
Minor visual improvements to the Port of London.
Changed the camera angle in Port and in battle.
Changed camera pathing during the pre-battle countdown.
Fixed the incorrect display of some ships' torpedo arming distance.
Fixed a bug that caused the aiming reticle to shift while on the move.
Fixed bug that caused https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_66da2bf0a3d0736ade533118e5131aab9b4f7c9367cbb0392c621e6888c23fe1.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngX Halland's torpedo damage to be 11,467 instead of the intended 10,700.
Fixed a bug that would cause shipbuilding sounds from the Dockyard interface to play in Port and in battle.
Fixed a bug that would prevent the sounds of submarines submerging and surfacing from playing.
Fixed a bug that could cause the game interface to freeze when switching quickly from the Clans tab to Port and back.
Fixed a bug that caused ships to not be able to move in some situations when autopilot was active.
Fixed the incorrect behavior of the overview camera for ship modules when changing Port.
Combat Missions and Rewards
You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. Community Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including containers with Premium ships, rare permanent camouflages, and other in-game items.

The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.7
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg
IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.
Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[table][tr][th]Dockyard
Camera Improvements
Submarine Improvements
British Battleships: Part 2
Other Changes[/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
Dockyard
Update 0.11.7 kicks off the construction of https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Puerto Rico at the Dockyard. The ship is armed with twelve 305 mm guns placed in four main battery turrets. The cruiser's AP shells have good damage-dealing capabilities and enhanced ricochet angles. The ship also has a large HP pool and good armor protection.

Rules
The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 40 phases. These shipbuilding phases can be completed by progressing through Dockyard combat missions or by spending {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,750 Doubloons to pass through each phase. The combat missions span Update 0.11.7, 0.11.8, and the first three weeks of 0.11.9. The Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the start of Update 0.11.10.

In total, you can progress through 34 out of 40 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions. Completing the 25th phase will reward you with https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngVII Huron with a 6-skill-point Commander and a Port slot. The final reward is https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Puerto Rico with the Ceremonial permanent camouflage, a Port slot, a Commander with 10 skill points, and a commemorative flag.
If you already have https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Puerto Rico and upon construction completion, you'll obtain a Puerto Rico Certificate, which can be exchanged in a special section of the Armory for one of the following rewards: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png35,000 Doubloons, 33,000 Steel, or 63,000 Research Points. Thus, you'll be able to purchase any other available Tier X ship for completing shipbuilding phases at the Dockyard. If you do not exchange your Puerto Rico Certificate for one of the resources before the release of Update 0.11.10, you will automatically receive {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png35,000 Doubloons when the update goes live.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e0aee92-0767-11ed-9ad0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e074c74-0767-11ed-88b1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e0e3a52-0767-11ed-937a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Camera Improvements
The battle camera will be improved in Update 0.11.7 to make gameplay experience more comfortable.
The base default view angle will be changed.
The camera performance when using Spotting Aircraft will be improved: Now, a player has two camera positions to choose from to make aiming while using Spotting Aircraft more comfortable.

Lower position, similar to the camera position without Spotting Aircraft.
Upper position, similar to the current camera position when using Spotting Aircraft.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6caa5666-0745-11ed-990b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ca0df28-0745-11ed-96e8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
New settings will be added.

Field of view: The setting allows players to set the angle of view themselves. The setting does not affect the Binocular mode.
Camera height: This allows you to raise and zoom out the camera from a ship.
Airstrike alternative controls: Enables dynamic camera zoom based on distance when using Airstrike.
When switching to Airstrike mode, the position of the main battery and torpedo launchers will be fixed.
The camera view angle in the torpedo launcher view is similar to that in the main battery view.
Improved camera performance when tracking flying shells and in replays. [hr][/hr]
Submarine Improvements
Submarines will receive a number of improvements in Update 0.11.7.

The Hydrophone consumable will be split into two—Echo-Ranging Set and Low-Frequency Hydrophone.
Echo-Ranging Set shows the position of surface ships and highlights the bottom topography.
Low-Frequency Hydrophone allows you to detect submerged submarines.
Hydrophone combines two different tasks and is often used to perform only one, while the second is performed in vain. Splitting the consumable will make playing submarines more comfortable by enabling you to activate exactly the equipment you need at a given time.

Both consumables will be available on all submarines. The settings of the new consumable types will change from the current version of Hydrophone.

Disabled guaranteed detection for submarines in submerged position.
Due to interaction specifics, it is common for submarines to accidentally detect each other. Because of this, they come under an airstrike and are forced into a duel with no possibility of safely disengaging. Disabling guaranteed detection will make playing submarines more comfortable, and in case players want to attack an enemy submarine, they will be able to use Low-Frequency Hydrophone.

The visual effect above a submarine when using sonar will also be displayed for the submarine herself.
The change will make playing submarines clearer and help players better understand enemy submarine interaction.
[hr][/hr]
British Battleships: Part 2
The Port of London has been updated as part of the continuation of Early Access to British battleships.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b57bad4a-0745-11ed-8f93-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b57ef054-0745-11ed-9857-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b582065e-0745-11ed-b5c8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Other Changes
Visual Improvements
Improved in-game shadow rendering for all presets. Added a new shadow quality preset—Very High. Increased detail level for High and Maximum presets.

Improved buoys. Increased model quality and added soft lamp flashing.

The minimum system requirements have been increased to require full support for DX 11 SHADER MODEL 5_0. The minimum required graphics cards are now GeForce GTX 460/Radeon HD 5770/Intel HD Graphics 4000. It will not be possible to run the game client on older graphics cards.

Other Changes
The Port of Rio de Janeiro has been added to the game to celebrate the 200th anniversary of Brazil's independence.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82acc10a-0746-11ed-be95-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82a8e6ca-0746-11ed-9857-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82ac13a4-0746-11ed-8f93-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82acd6d6-0746-11ed-bf91-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Updated the drop rates of items from the "Two Titans—One King" Premium container. The containers that players have on their accounts will be changed accordingly with the release of the Update:
Chances of dropping expendable camouflages reduced from 29% to 21%.
Chances of dropping permanent camouflages increased from 7% to 12%.
Chances of dropping Commanders increased from 14% to 15%.
Chances of dropping expendable economic bonuses increased from 40% to 42%.
Number of containers that must be opened to guarantee the acquisition of one of the permanent camouflages—unless dropped from one of the open containers—reduced from 35 to 20.

Update 0.11.6 launches a whole new branch of Tier III to X British battleships into Early Access. Equipped with powerful torpedoes and main guns that don’t have a particularly long reach, the new sea giants will show their worth at medium- to knife-duel distances. The Repair Party consumable they have on board regenerates a decent chunk of any lost HP.

The battleships carry HE shells with standard penetration capabilities, their accuracy is fairly average, and the AP shells they fire have a typically British fuse time. Their main batteries are solid enough, with calibers reaching up to 457 mm at Tier X. Ships of Tiers V and above can take advantage of Engine Boost. Starting from Tier VI, these battleships will be a bitter bite for aircraft as they get Defensive AA Fire; starting from Tier IX, Repair Party is swapped for Specialized Repair Teams.

The new British battleships won't be available on the Public Test server.

One of the key new features of the update is a temporary event called Industry Titans. The Chatham, Elswick, and Clydebank shipyards will compete for the right to be called the best shipbuilder serving the needs of the Royal Navy.

Make your choice and lend your support to one of the shipyards! Keep in mind that each shipyard will be offering its own unique reward—a British Commander with 6 skill points and a researchable British Tier V ship (https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngV Hawkins, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.pngV Emerald, or https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.pngV Acasta).
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b68920e-f0a7-11ec-a2ff-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The Titans of Industry event is similar to previous events that we’ve held, including the New Year's Eve, Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry, Battle of the Beasts, and Clash of Courage events.

Dive into the event on the Live Server to earn British Tokens that you can be exchange for Early Access ships, permanent camouflages, and other items.
The Port of London has been updated to celebrate the event.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7a02966a-f12f-11ec-a811-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7a21f884-f12f-11ec-b2ea-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7a261a5e-f12f-11ec-bbf4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Separation of Exterior Visuals and Economic Bonuses
Update 0.11.6 kicks off a major overhaul of the economic component of the game by separating the visual element from economic bonuses.



While working on the update, we aimed to achieve several goals:
Offer an option to select economic bonuses and visual elements (camouflages) separately.
Simplify management of economic bonuses.
Make sure the transition from the old system to the new one is as comfortable as possible.
Maintain the current state of the in-game economy in terms of costs and earnings.
We’ve improved the interface, bonus management, Inventory display, and much more! The key principle behind this effort is that you as players do not lose in your overall earnings. In certain scenarios, you actually gain even more than before.
Below is a brief list of the key changes. For a deeper look into the separation process, please refer to our Development Blog.

List of Changes
Economic bonuses will now act as individual in-game entities that are separate from camouflages and signals. Camouflage patterns will change a ship's exterior only and will be applied separately from these bonuses.
Bonuses to XP will have no effect on Free XP and Commander XP. To compensate for this, we have changed all permanent and expendable economic bonuses.
Basic Free XP earnings are now twice as large.
Economic bonuses from permanent camouflages are purchased separately, and their effect will be applied towards a ship's economy on a permanent basis. Expendable bonuses can also be added on top of permanent ones.
Only one economic bonus can be applied towards each of the resources (Credits, combat XP, Free XP, and Commander XP) at the same time. This limitation serves to simplify the way the system works. The values of these bonuses are designed in a way that they can cover even the most profitable combinations from the current system.
Instead of reducing the post-battle service cost, permanent camouflages will provide a bonus to Credits so that your average earnings either remain unchanged or grow.
The service cost for Tier IX and X researchable ships has been reduced from {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png120,000 to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png115,000 and from {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png180,000 to {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png150,000 Credits, respectively.
To account for the changes to bonuses applied towards service costs, the current service cost in Co-op Battles will be additionally reduced by 13.3% while Credits earnings will grow by 12.5%.
We want camouflages to affect ship exteriors only, so we’re removing all the combat bonuses they used to offer. The bonus that provided a 3% reduction in the detectability range by sea is now included in all ships' tech specs by default. We also removed the bonus that increased the dispersion of incoming enemy shells by 4%.
At present, the number of signals and camouflages displayed in the Exterior tab does not include those currently mounted on your ships. When this change goes live, you will always know the exact number of reserves you have in stock—the total number of signals and camouflage patterns you have on your account will be displayed.
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6e613c8-f12f-11ec-ad63-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6ec0152-f12f-11ec-bbf4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6e5ce86-f12f-11ec-972c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6ebb0da-f12f-11ec-b67d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
This change, along with the addition of the new in-game entity, entails a revision of all rewards in the game. In combat missions, campaigns, Operations, and collections—economic and special signals will be replaced with bonuses. Camouflages will also be supplemented with bonuses.
The contents of all containers that drop signals or camouflages will also change.
Apart from that, the following two account access levels are going to be added to support the upcoming changes:
Level 5, unlocking combat bonuses for a ship
Level 7, unlocking economic bonuses for a ship
It means that we’re increasing the total number of access levels to 17. At the same time, the total number of battles that need to be played to unlock the access levels will not change. All of your current progress toward unlocking access levels will be retained, meaning that you won't lose any progress and will still get any due rewards.
[hr][/hr]
AI Updates
In Update 0.11.6, we've substantially upgraded the AI behind our bot ships in Training and Co-op Battles.
We’ve enhanced the AI responsible for bots moving, firing, and using consumables in Training Battles.
In Co-op Battles, AI-controlled aircraft carriers will now move to the nearest Key Area if only a few surviving allies are left in battle.
Bots will now be less likely to ram one another or strike islands in Co-op Battles. [hr][/hr]
Updates to U.S. Destroyer Models

notes.title: Updated Convoy in Update 0.11.5
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/567c483954a7a6fbfcc1912ef3087154790fc6aa.jpg
Update 0.11.5 brings back the Convoy temporary battle type, which tasks you with defending or attacking transport ships as they sail to their destination point.

We've updated the format and diversified the maps, as well as increased the number of transport ships that now move along different routes. We've also revamped the interface and tactical tips in battle, as well as changed the description of the Convoy rules in the battle-type selection window.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e51943fa-ebed-11ec-ae3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
In real life, naval battles involved more than squadron duels and air raids. A significant aspect of confrontations between navies involved defending or attacking cargo lanes used to transport strategically important cargo.

[table][tr][th]Rules
Achievements and Combat Missions[/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
Rules
To ensure high-quality matchmaking and contribute to battles being assembled more quickly, Convoy is only available during a certain Prime Time period each day.

Format
12 vs. 12 with Tier VIII–X ships.

Convoy will be available throughout Update 0.11.5.

We've changed some conditions of Convoy to bring more variety to the tactics of both teams and diversify the gameplay in this battle type.

Aircraft carriers, destroyers, cruisers, battleships, and submarines are allowed to participate.

Two teams participate in each battle—one is tasked with escorting cargo ships, and the other is tasked with attacking them. Players are randomly distributed among the two teams. You can enter each battle either alone or as part of a Division of 2—3 players.

The defending team needs to escort convoys of cargo ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire enemy team is sent back to Port. The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoys or its defenders.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314653f2-ebe5-11ec-b84a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314aa86c-ebe5-11ec-b8aa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314d67e6-ebe5-11ec-bfc8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3147d0ce-ebe5-11ec-90a1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1fd37b04-ebdb-11ec-9ff5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f3eb7d0-ebdb-11ec-bd60-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
In total, there are six AI-controlled transport ships in each battle. Depending on the map, transport ships will be split into three convoys of two ships or two convoys of three ships.
Each convoy moves along its own route.
Each route has its own destination. The destination points may be the same or different.
The convoy's route is visible to both teams on the Minimap.
The numbering of routes is tied to their travel time—the higher the number, the longer the duration of the route.
All convoys are made up of Liberty-class transport ships. They have little HP and weak armor, but they can deploy smoke screens, as well as change speed and maneuver to dodge enemy torpedoes. In addition, the transport ships are armed with two main battery guns and twelve secondary battery guns capable of firing at approaching enemies.
Maps
North, Hotspot, Trap, Two Brothers, Tears of the Desert, Crash Zone Alpha. A cyclone can appear on the Trap map.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558addcc-ebe6-11ec-ae3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558b3362-ebe6-11ec-a4eb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5592ffca-ebe6-11ec-9ff5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558ed2f6-ebe6-11ec-a3b0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558cb700-ebe6-11ec-b8aa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55919a36-ebe6-11ec-bfc8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558d7f82-ebe6-11ec-a2ee-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Achievements and Combat Missions
As before, your successes in Convoy will be rewarded with special themed achievements. We've updated their visual appearance for the new iteration.
[table equalcells=1][tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d86f7b8-ebd8-11ec-822f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]Living Shield[/td] [td]Receive two torpedo hits from the enemy while being within a 2-kilometer radius of an allied transport ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d86c1c6-ebd8-11ec-8e96-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]Neat Job[/td] [td]Win by destroying all the transports and without losing any allied ships. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9ddc5c12-ebd8-11ec-9882-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]Safe Route[/td] [td]Win a battle and save all transports. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d8a9972-ebd8-11ec-a75f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]Nerves of Steel[/td] [td]Win and survive in a battle when the enemy has twice the number of warships or more. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship. Can be completed while playing for any team.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d8f7dac-ebd8-11ec-ac73-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/td] [td]Raider[/td] [td]Destroy two transports in a single battle.[/td][/tr][/table]
Due to the specifics of the battle type, you can only earn these achievements in Convoy.
You will have access to special combat missions that can be completed only in Convoy. Win and earn Base XP to obtain Community Tokens.
Detailed information about the special mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.

Commanders, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.5! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!
Changelog
Made balance changes to the Kansas-Vermont branch of American battleships, Unites States, and submarines. See our Development Blog for details.
Fixed the external code execution technical vulnerability in World of Warships' replay tool. We thank those who brought the problem to our attention.
Fixed an issue because of which the FPS limit in battle was not removed in Update 0.11.4. This limit has now been removed for all players. If you want to set it manually, edit the [code][/code] value in the preferences.xml file in the game folder.
Corrected the display of an outdated tech tree. The tech tree now matches Update 0.11.4.
Thanks to your feedback, it was discovered that after completing the relevant combat missions on the 0.11.5 Public Test, players received Commander Dasha only for the Tier I ship of her respective version's nation. The rewards have been changed, and now battles on each nation's Tier X ship will bring several Dasha Commanders with a specialization for that nation's Tier X ships. We thank you for your feedback and for bringing this issue to our attention.
Updated the routes and fixed a number of bugs in the Convoy battle type's interface.
Fixed an issue that caused submarines to be incorrectly positioned at the beginning of battles in the Standard Battle and Domination modes on some maps.
Fixed a number of issues on the maps Northern Waters, Shards, and Faroe Islands, as well as on Operation Narai's map.
Fixed an issue that caused the Division invitation window to move arbitrarily on the screen.
Fixed an issue that caused the markers for submarines' homing torpedoes to not be displayed on the minimap.
Combat Missions and Rewards
You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. These Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.

Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.5
IMPORTANT! Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.
Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[table][tr][th]The Return of Convoy
Updated U.S. Destroyer Models
Faroe Islands
Submarines
Other Changes
Transformers[/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
The Return of Convoy
Military operations at sea didn't only involve duels between squadrons or air raids against enemy ships. In real life, a significant aspect of confrontations between navies involved defending or attacking cargo lanes used to transport strategically important cargo. During Update 0.10.8, you had an opportunity to participate in a separate battle type—Convoy—in which you had to either defend or destroy cargo ships. We've updated the rules and format, and Convoy is going to return in Update 0.11.5!

Format
[expand type=details]
The battles will be fought in teams of 12 with Tier VIII–X ships.

Players can participate in Convoy playing submarines as well. The limit on the number of submarines is identical to Random Battles.
[/expand]
Rules
[expand type=details]
Two teams participate in each battle—one is tasked with escorting cargo ships, and the other is tasked with attacking them. Players are randomly distributed among the two teams.

The defending team needs to escort a convoy of AI-controlled cargo ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire enemy team is destroyed. The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.
[/expand]
Maps
[expand type=details]
North, Hotspot, Trap, Two Brothers, Tears of the Desert, Haven, Crash Zone Alpha, Northern Waters.

The defending team needs to escort a total of six transport ships. Depending on the map, they are divided into convoys of two or three ships, and each convoy follows its own route. This means that you can expect two or three convoy routes with either the same destination or different ones. This change allows for new tactics for both teams and makes the gameplay more diverse. At the same time, we've reduced the number of Convoy ships respectively for each route so as not to complicate the task for the attacking team and to avoid performance issues in battle.
[/expand]
Apart from changing the rules and format, we've also updated the interface and tactical hints in battle, as well as the Convoy rules in the battle mode selection window.

Updated U.S. Destroyer Models
We're starting to update the models of U.S. destroyers. In Update 0.11.5, the models of  VII Mahan,  VIII Benson,  IX Fletcher, and  X Gearing are going to be revamped. In Update 0.11.6, we're going to revamp the models of  III Wickes,  IV Clemson,  V Nicholas,  VI Farragut, and  VII Sims.

The changes will slightly affect the aiming angles of torpedo tubes and main battery guns, anti-aircraft and anti-submarine defense composition, and the distribution of HP in different parts of the ships. The gameplay features of these ships will not change.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09a6c448-d822-11ec-a297-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/099f0316-d822-11ec-90cd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09a6d5b4-d822-11ec-a9d7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09ad3670-d822-11ec-b0e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Faroe Islands
In autumn of 2021, players helped us choose the visual style for the new map. It has now passed through the final stages of preparation, and we're ready to introduce the new Faroe Islands map in Update 0.11.5!

Battles will take place among flowing mountains covered with a thin layer of snow and islands with steep shores. The map has been designed for battles involving Tier VII–X ships, as well as superships. It can be found in the Domination mode with three or four Key Areas.

You'll be able to check out the Faroe Islands map during the Public Test of Update 0.11.5!    https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d1029c2a-d830-11ec-a66c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d100e952-d830-11ec-971e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d0f4d6c6-d830-11ec-80c5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Submarines
In Update 0.11.5, changes are going to be made to the matchmaker based on player feedback regarding submarines. The limit on the number of submarines and destroyers in a team will depend on the waiting time of the first player in the queue:
0–39 seconds: Four ships total; no more than four destroyers and two submarines.
40–89 seconds: Five ships total; no more than four destroyers and two submarines.
In case of longer waiting times for the first player, these limits will be less strict. [hr][/hr]
Other Changes
Changes to rental Commander management:
Rental Commanders can no longer be reassigned to different ships. Rental Commanders with specializations for different ships won't be shown in the Commander Replacement tab.
If a ship had several rental Commanders, only one of them with the highest number of skill points and most XP will remain. The rest of the rental Commanders will be removed from player accounts.[hr][/hr]
Transformers
During this new stage of our collaboration with Hasbro, the game will see the return of the Autobots and Decepticons, as well as other themed content. notes.title: Arms Race Hits Random and Co-op Battles in Update 0.11.4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9f50dfc0d6e5d944eb11941981a9a1e0b1fce434.jpg
Update 0.11.4 brings Arms Race—a mode that allows you to improve the characteristics of your ship right in battle—into Random and Co-op Battles.

With the addition of Arms Race to Random and Co-op Battles, we're disabling Epicenter.

[table][tr][th]Rules
Features of Arms Race
How Buff Areas Work
Buff Types[/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
Rules
Arms Race will be available only in battles where the highest ship tier is IX or X, as well as in battles with superships. You can enter a battle in a Division of no more than three players. The number of players and matchmaking restrictions are the same as those applied in Random and Co-op Battles.

It will also be available only on these eight maps: Northern Waters, Sleeping Giant, Loop, Warrior’s Path, Mountain Range, Land of Fire, Islands of Ice, and Hotspot.

[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1abcd6aa-d29b-11ec-91d2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac437c4-d29b-11ec-b168-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b66a0ae-d29b-11ec-a66e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac27984-d29b-11ec-abbb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac4112c-d29b-11ec-b4bc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b67d456-d29b-11ec-8a8c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac7ff30-d29b-11ec-890f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac67aa2-d29b-11ec-a14f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand] [hr][/hr]
Features of Arms Race
Once a battle starts, areas with buffs spawn on the map. If you can make it to a special area and pick up the buffs before your opponents do, your entire team will get a bonus to their combat abilities till the end of that battle.

Eight minutes after a battle starts, a Key Area appears in the center of the map. The diameter of this area then shrinks over time. The team that captures it will be able to quickly gain an advantage in points and greatly increase their chances of winning. The capture time is 120 seconds. Holding an area brings 10 points every 2 seconds.

To win a battle, a team will need to meet one of the following conditions:
Sink all enemy ships
Be the first to score 1,000 superiority points
Reduce the opposing team's points to zero
Prevail over the opposing team by the number of points at the time the battle ends
[expand style=more]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34acb83e-d285-11ec-a866-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/354b3cac-d285-11ec-a119-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35431036-d285-11ec-95b6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34a520ba-d285-11ec-b748-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/expand]
Battles in the Arms Race mode will bring players the standard sums of XP and Credits they would get in Random or Co-op Battles (depending on which type of battle they are in). Activating buff areas will also be rewarded.
[hr][/hr]
How Buff Areas Work
Each buff area becomes available to capture 2 minutes after spawning. The player whose ship first enters the area after its activation gets a buff for their ship and all allies.

If both allied and enemy ships are in a buff area at the moment of its activation, the team with the most ships in the area gets the buff. If the ship numbers are equal, the balance of power inside the area must shift one way or another for a team to receive the buff.

In addition to the buffs, each captured area grants 20 points to your team and deducts 20 points from the enemy team. Players who capture a buff area receive an economic reward of XP and Credits. New buff areas appear on the map every 2 minutes until the 14th minute of each battle. Buff areas spawn randomly on maps, so every battle is unique!
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/88c7e8a8-d299-11ec-a14f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg [hr][/hr]
Buff Types
Permanent HP recovery for ships and carrier aircraft:
Restores +0.04% HP per second for destroyers and submarines
Restores +0.03% HP per second for cruisers
Restores +0.02% HP per second for battleships
Restores +0.125% HP per second for carrier aircraft
Faster reload time for all ship armaments; faster squadron preparation time for aircraft carriers:
−10% to the reload time of all armaments and sonar
−10% to squadron restoration time
Boosted armament damage for ships and carrier squadrons:
+10% to maximum ship armament damage
+10% to maximum armament damage of carrier and hybrid ship squadrons
Increased current and maximum HP values for ships and carrier squadrons:
+10% to current and maximum HP of destroyers and submarines
+7.5% to current and maximum HP of cruisers
+5% to current and maximum HP of battleships
+17% to current and maximum HP of carrier squadrons
Each buff has three levels. The bonuses stack up if you capture the same buffs multiple times. All four buff types can be applied to a ship simultaneously.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0e948830-d4fa-11ec-8d47-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Picking up a buff that you have already maxed out will have no effect. Capturing a buff area will bring 20 superiority points to your team and deduct 20 points from the enemy team. Buff areas disappear after being captured.

In early February, we announced our plans for 2022. Over the months since our previous publication, many of our ideas have been implemented. More information about future changes to World of Warships is now available and some details have changed. It's high time we shared our development plans for the second half of 2022!
