Starting from Update 0.10.1, the following ships will no longer be available to obtain: https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Georgia, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngIX Alaska, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVIII Massachusetts, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Thunderer, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Småland. Georgia, Alaska, and Massachusetts will also no longer be available to purchase in the Premium Shop.

The ships have been taken out of the game due to a combination of their popularity and combat efficiency. In order to maintain the proper level of diversity in teams in terms of the ships they are made up of, these ships will no longer be available to obtain for an indefinite period of time, but may return in future.

From Update 0.10.2, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.pngX Somers will cease to be available in the Armory for an indefinite period of time. She will be replaced by another American ship—https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Austin.

We understand that accumulating resources for ships is a long process, which is why we wanted to warn you in advance, so that any interested players can still steer these ships into their Ports before Updates 0.10.1 and 0.10.2 go live in about 2 and 3 months' time.

Game Balance Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0de6ed8-32d7-11eb-81b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In Update 0.9.12, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their combat efficiency and feedback from players. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

Kansas
Sigma parameter increased from 1.6 to 1.7
Armor penetration of shells increased by approximately 3.5%
Minnesota
Armor penetration of shells increased by approximately 4%
Tallinn
Armor penetration of shells increased by approximately 12.5%
Admiral Hipper
Main battery reload time reduced from 11.5 to 11 s
Hōshō
Number of torpedo bombers in a squadron reduced from 6 to 5
Size of an attacking flight of torpedo bombers decreased from 2 to 1
Number of torpedo bombers on the deck reduced from 9 to 8
Torpedo bomber restoration time increased from 59 to 71 s
Torpedo damage increased from 5,400 to 5,800
Langley
Torpedo damage reduced from 4,233 to 3,500
Chances of causing flooding with torpedoes reduced from 33% to 30%
Manfred von Richthofen
The area of the reticle ellipse of bombers has been increased
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0f9be858-404b-11eb-a1c0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Fixed an issue that resulted in excessive deceleration when Engine Boost was used. The value has been adjusted to match the standard one.
Implacable
Maximum bomb damage increased from 5,300 to 5,600
Chances of bombs causing fire on a target increased from 30% to 32%
Audacious
Number of rockets carried by standard attack aircraft reduced from 12 to 10
Number of rockets carried by researchable attack aircraft reduced from 14 to 12
Maximum bomb damage increased from 6,000 to 6,400
Chances of bombs causing fire on a target increased from 35% to 36%
Technical Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0d992ae-3fb2-11eb-8a73-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

As part of the game server component optimization, we’re reducing the maximum number of unopened containers on player accounts to 100. If you have more than 100 unopened containers at the time of the release of Update 0.9.12, the containers that you obtained earliest will be opened automatically.

Support of Mac OS
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/409361c8-3fad-11eb-9d23-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

We plan to cease support for Mac OS in January 2021. We made this decision due to the low popularity of this operating system among our audience. Supporting Mac OS restrains our ability to improve the visuals of the game and its overall performance. You can find more details in this Player Support article.

Developer Bulletin for Update 0.10.0
Updates to the Commander skill system, Clan Brawls, Lunar New Year, and other new features.
IMPORTANT! Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the Update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the Update is released.
Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[table][tr][th]Commander Skills Update ● Brawls ● Other Changes[/th][/tr][/table]
Commander Skills Update
World of Warships is constantly evolving. New mechanics and ships with unique gameplay appear in the game on a regular basis. To ensure that Commander skills correspond to the current state of the game, we're carrying out a large-scale update by adding new skills and changing the old ones. Changing the Commander skill system will make it more flexible and convenient, and give you a choice between several effective loadout options instead of one ultimate go-to option. This will enable you to customize your ship to more precisely suit your playstyle. In addition to updating the Commander skills, we've revamped the interface and made it more comfortable to use the Commander system, as well as retrain and level up Commanders.

Skills
Each Commander now has separate skill sections for each ship type. Skill points in each section are distributed independently of each other.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d2979120-3936-11eb-b817-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d283af48-3936-11eb-9b52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d28684c0-3936-11eb-96cf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d286395c-3936-11eb-b6d6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The skill section corresponding to the chosen ship type is active in battle.
As skills have become more specialized and their total number has increased, the maximum possible number of Commander skill points has increased from 19 to 21.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13540882-3938-11eb-9b52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Elite Commander XP
Commanders who don't have the maximum number of skill points will additionally bring you Elite Commander XP in the amount of 5% of the Commander XP gained.
For Commanders with 21 skill points, any XP earned is converted into Elite XP; the additional 5% is not credited.
When dismissing a Commander, you can convert some of their Commander XP into Elite XP:
Up to 25% of the Commander XP, at the cost of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png10 credits for 1 XP.
Up to 50% of the Commander XP, at the cost of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1 doubloon for 150 XP.

For example, if a Commander has 10,000 XP, then upon dismissing this Commander, you can receive up to 2,500 XP for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png25,000 credits; or up to 4,950 XP for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png33 doubloons.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/133c67d6-3938-11eb-b14b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Retraining and Specialization
The ability to accelerate Commander retraining in exchange for credits has been removed, but the amount of XP required for retraining has been halved.
Skills will not work until the Commander's retraining is complete.
Each skill section is reset separately from the others.
A Commander without a specialization for a ship can't be assigned to that ship without retraining. This rule doesn't apply to Premium and special ships.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13435fd2-3938-11eb-b6d6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Other Changes
The cost and number of skills for recruited Commanders will change so that, if necessary, a player will be able to recruit a Commander with more skill points.
Commander without skills: recruited free of charge.
Commander with 6 skill points: available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png900,000 credits.
Commander with 10 skill points: available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,750 doubloons.
You can enter battle playing a ship without an assigned Commander. In this case, you will not earn Commander XP.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/135c4b00-3938-11eb-b817-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
You can learn more details about the changes to the Commander skill system on the Development Blog.
Brawls
The upcoming Update ushers in two Brawls with a 7 vs. 7 format:
From January 26 to February 1 for Tier VIII ships.
From February 9–15 for Tier X ships.
Battles will be fought in the Arms Race mode without aircraft carriers and with a limit of two battleships per team. To participate in these Brawls, it's enough for only the Commander to be a member of a Clan: up to six mercenaries can be invited to the team.

Other Changes
Please note: new ships, camouflages, and Commanders will not be available on the Public Test Server.
We've added special content dedicated to the Lunar New Year: Wujing and Sanzang in the Sha Wujing and Tang Sanzang permanent camouflages, together with themed Commanders; Fen Yang with the Lunar New Year permanent camouflage; and two types of the "Journey to the West" containers. To mark the celebrations, we've updated the Dragon Port.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13862434-3938-11eb-83d8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
To make it more explicit, we've updated the display of Early Access ships in the Tech Tree, as well as the description of their features.
The segment split of torpedo bombers' reticles now depends on the number of aircraft in the attacking flight. This fixes an issue that prevented the display of some of lines in the reticle.
Pressing the F key after attacking with the last flight in a squadron will skip the attack animation and transition you to controlling the ship.
When a squadron takes off, the aircraft models no longer disappear from the deck of an aircraft carrier all at once, but rather disappear in turn.
We've updated the interface for carrier armaments in the Port.
The message about the return of a squadron to their carrier has been removed.
The game now loads while a video is played on the loading screen.

American Battleships

American battleships https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Kansas, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Minnesota, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Vermont will become available for all players to research.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59963166-fe56-11ea-a399-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/58b76ac6-fe56-11ea-b102-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd348f8e-32e4-11eb-842f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Features of the Branch
Numerous main battery guns with a solid salvo weight and firing range, which come at the expense of longer gun reloading times.
Great maneuverability for battleships and effective anti-torpedo protection, but rather a low speed.
Decent AA defenses that can be reinforced with the Defensive AA Fire consumable.
Winter Trophies
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b12b4744-32d7-11eb-8b11-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Update 0.9.11 brings you the first batch of gifts and festive New Year activities.

Free random bundles in the Armory
The bundles are available between December 4–22, 05:00 UTC
You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip up to 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b23de712-32d8-11eb-98b7-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
We'll give you some indicators to jog your memory about claiming your rewards by highlighting the Armory banner with a color, as well as attaching a special icon and text notification to it.
New Year Gifts
Gear up for the time of gifts in World of Warships! From December 4, bundles that include three types of Santa's containers are scheduled to become available. Exchanging doubloons for them in the Armory is one of several ways in which they can be obtained.

Each festive container holds a reward: doubloons, days of Premium Account, Coal, Free XP, expendable camouflages, signals—or one of the 107 Premium ships!

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c82cbac-32e5-11eb-ad6e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c7fe810-32e5-11eb-842f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c24dc5e-32e5-11eb-821f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Combat Mission Groups: Winter Trophies
The new game event tasks you with completing 21 missions spread across three combat mission groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.9.11, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis. The final reward for completing the last group is the New Year permanent camouflage for Tier VIII ships.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/347d257c-32e7-11eb-842f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The combat mission groups will be available until the release of Update 0.9.12. More details about the completion criteria for the missions are available in the game client.
Advent Calendar
The Advent Calendar festivities kick off on December 1 and run until December 31. Open cards, get rewards, and complete missions to get even more rewards! More details about the Advent Calendar will follow in a dedicated article.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2885081624995503857
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5f01cfca-3317-11eb-b3a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Battle Performance Bonuses
An alternative option is opening up for you to get Research Points for resetting ship branches, as well as temporary victory bonuses. All you need to do now is earn 300 base XP. Claim bonuses by playing your favorite battle type!

Victory Bonuses have been replaced with "Battle Performance Bonuses" across all descriptions in the game client.

Brawls
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0e9d0fc-32d7-11eb-8039-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Due to technical issues the Ranked Battles system update has been delayed to a later update.
Update 0.9.11 ushers in Clan Brawls 12 and 13. Brawls are now open to all players, even if a player isn't currently in a Clan. To participate, apply via the Create Division menu near the "Battle!" button, then wait for an invitation to join a Division. Only the Commander who creates a Division for a Brawl is required to be part of a Clan; the other two invitees do not have to belong to any Clan at all.

The ship is available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png228,000 Coal, as well as in bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons.

Starting from Update 0.10.1, the following ships will no longer be available: IX Georgia, IX Alaska, VIII Massachusetts, X Thunderer, and X Småland. Georgia, Alaska, and Massachusetts will no longer be available to purchase in the Premium Shop.

The ships have been taken out of the game due to a combination of their popularity and combat efficiency. In order to maintain the proper level of diversity in teams in terms of the ships they are made up of, these ships will no longer be available to obtain for an indefinite period of time, but may return in future.

We understand that accumulating resources for ships is a long process, which is why we wanted to warn you in advance, so that any interested players can still steer these ships into their Ports before Update 0.10.1 goes live in about 3 months' time.

Other Changes
Changes to banners in the Port
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/857e5130-32ec-11eb-9dd2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

The banners of the Armory and Premium Shop will now announce the arrival of new items, coupons, and temporary specials.

We've added pop-up windows to the Dockyard banner to give players status reports on the current shipbuilding phase.

Game Balance Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0de6ed8-32d7-11eb-81b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In Update 0.9.11, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their combat efficiency and feedback from players. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

Soviet Tier X destroyer Khabarovsk, and Japanese Tier X destroyer Harugumo
Loss of HP after being hit by an AP or SAP shell with a caliber of 280 mm and above will now not exceed 10% of the maximum damage that such a shell can cause.
British Tier VIII aircraft carrier Implacable
Maximum bomb damage increased from 5,100 to 5,300
Chances of a bomb causing fire on target increased from 29% to 30%
American Tier VIII battleship Kansas
Sigma parameter increased from 1.5 to 1.6
Japanese Tier IX destroyer Kitakaze
Detectability range by sea increased from 7.56 to 7.76 km. Other detectability values have been increased accordingly.
Content Additions and Changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0f8c90e-32d7-11eb-992d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

The following ships have been added for testing by developers, supertesters, and community contributors: IV Dante Alighieri, V Conte di Cavour, IX Lepanto, IX Marco Polo, X Vampire II, and VIII Fen Yang.

The Gothic permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Bismarck is now available in exchange for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png5,000 doubloons via the Exterior tab.

The exterior setting of the Naval Base Port has been reverted back to its initial design.

Other Changes and Improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0e520ac-32d7-11eb-85e9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In January 2021, we're going to cease support for macOS. We've made this decision due to the low popularity of the operating system among our audience. Supporting macOS restrains our ability to improve the visuals of the game and its overall performance. More details are available from Player Support.
We've added sound effects for some animations in the Port for the following themed permanent camouflages from the Transformers universe: Freedom Fighter for X Montana, Gold Bug for X Gearing, Messenger of Oblivion for X Großer Kurfürst, and Crush ’n’ Destroy for X Khabarovsk.
Added an option to disable screen shaking from incoming damage and when using Engine Boost for squadrons with a new "Camera feedback when damage is taken" setting in the Controls tab.
The Key Battle ships have been removed from player accounts. Any XP earned playing those ships has been transferred to I Erie.
We've removed the option to set an Autopilot course by clicking a square on the Minimap.
Removed Naval Legends audio files from the res/userMusiс folder. You can listen to all of our podcasts here.
When previewing camouflage patterns in the Armory, a block will be displayed with the ship's tech specs adjusted for the effects and bonuses of the camouflage being previewed.
Added an option to launch replays without pop-up notifications about opening files of such a format in Windows.
Fixed an issue that caused the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable to work incorrectly.
Fixed an issue that, when locking onto a target with main battery guns, set an incorrect angle for the torpedo launchers. As a result, torpedoes could be sent in the wrong direction or the launchers could malfunction entirely.
Fixed an issue that caused the game client to crash after navigating to the Dockyard but before the ship being built had appeared in it.
Fixed an issue that caused aerial torpedoes to arm at incorrect distances from the target.
Fixed an issue that caused the game client to freeze on the login screen.
Fixed an issue that disabled the display of certain indicators (distance to aiming point, detectability, and shell flight time) for aircraft in battle with the alternative battle interface mode enabled.
Fixed an issue that caused Andrew Cunningham's "Lightning Fast" talent to provide an incorrect bonus to the speed of aircraft.
Fixed an issue that caused a screenshot from the previous battle to pop up before displaying the battle results.
Other improvements and changes. The full list is available from Player Support.
Attentive readers can expect a reward! All you need to do is click the "Get Reward" button, and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png1 day of Premium Account will be yours! Please note: your day of Premium Account starts immediately after clicking the button, so make sure to dive straight into the game and make best use of it.

The game event in Update 0.9.10 is presented by combat missions, Daily Shipments, and a new collection dedicated to the U.S. Navy.

For the purposes of standardization, Directives have been renamed "combat mission groups."

Please note: American Tokens can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory until the event ends. After the end of the event, they will be exchanged for credits at the rate of 1:1,000.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png The possibility to make this exchange will be available until:  Thu. 03 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

Combat mission groups {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Start:  Thu. 29 Oct. 06:15 CET (UTC+1)
End:  Tue. 01 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)

Rewards for completing the missions and groups: signal flags, camouflages, Coal, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, and Always Courageous containers.

Always Courageous containers
How to get the containers
Up to 27 containers—by completing combat mission groups.
Up to 4 containers—from Daily Shipments.
Up to 10 containers—by completing special combat missions from the official World of Warships streams.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ad70767a-153f-11eb-90b0-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
Each Always Courageous container includes:
An element of the Always Courageous collection.
1x special signal (Dragon, Wyvern, Red Dragon, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan), or 1x Stars 'n' Stripes camouflage.
One of the following: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png600 Coal; {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png500 Free XP; 1,500 Elite Commander XP; 3x signals of the same type (Zulu, Papa Papa, Equal Speed Charlie London, India Bravo Terrathree, Zulu Hotel); or {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png50,000 credits.
You can purchase Always Courageous Premium containers, which offer more rewards, in the Premium Shop, or obtain them in exchange for doubloons in the Armory. The rewards are as follows:
An element of the Always Courageous collection.
15x special signals of the same type (Dragon, Wyvern, Red Dragon, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan), or 12x Stars 'n' Stripes camouflages.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png3,400 Coal; or {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png8,500 Free XP; or 3x Type 59 camouflages.
The "Always Courageous" collection
The newly added "Always Courageous" collection comprises four sections, with four elements in each. It will educate you about the main batteries of battleships, admirals, and medals for service in both World Wars, as well as the main uniform types of enlisted men of the U.S. Navy during World War II.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2d86a974-1540-11eb-8e52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Reward for completing the sections: 5x Stars 'n' Stripes expendable camouflages; Wings, Stars, and Stars 'n' Stripes patches.
Reward for completing the collection: https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngV Oklahoma in the Military permanent camouflage, and a Commander with 6 skill points.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82791656-1540-11eb-9384-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngV Oklahoma is a Nevada-class battleship, the unique feature of which is her ten 356 mm main caliber guns placed in two twin turrets and two triple turrets. The guns are accurate, have a decent firing range, and cause significant damage per salvo, but take rather a long time to reload. In close quarters, the battleship can make use of her accurate secondary battery guns.

The exchange rate for duplicates is 4:1. To exchange duplicates, you need to select a vacant slot in a collection section, then confirm that you want to exchange your duplicates for the missing item in the window that appears.
Elements of the collection can only be obtained from event-related containers. In Update 0.10.5, we're planning to add Always Courageous containers to the Armory. They will be available in exchange for Coal. Thus, you'll still be able to complete the collection and obtain https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngV Oklahoma if you haven't managed to do so in Update 0.9.10. The exact cost of the containers will be announced later.
Daily Shipments
During Update 0.9.10, enter the game in the period between October 29 and November 12, inclusive, to start getting valuable rewards via the Daily Shipments section.

You can get a total of 10 rewards, while the shipments are available for 14 days. Thus, you can skip 4 days out of 2 weeks and still claim all the valuable rewards.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40edcc9a-153b-11eb-b828-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
When Update 0.9.11 goes live, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Kansas, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Minnesota, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Vermont will leave Early Access and become available for all players to research.

Key Battle
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5e6c0a78-153d-11eb-8481-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
A new temporary battle type—Key Battle—has been added in Update 0.9.10. Demonstrate your skills in a futuristic competition by assuming command over a ship representing one of three corporations!
The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on the gigantic Polygon map.
You start out alone, but you can gather a team of up to three ships directly in battle.
For destroying monsters and other players, you'll get a temporary resource—Battle Points. Having accumulated a certain number of Battle Points, you can also reinforce your ship directly in battle.
The Battle Points you receive aren't lost or spent in battle. You can exchange them for rewards in the Armory.
You'll find a monster with a key closer to the center of the map. If you destroy it, the monster will drop a key that will allow you to escape via the Portal.
Once all the keys have been used or the Portal is closed, the remaining ships will be transported to a special area—the Octagon. The final battle takes place in a gradually shrinking combat zone. The last surviving ship will leave the Polygon successfully.
Successfully escaping the Polygon will bring you additional Battle Points.
Each of the three available ships offers a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on the gameplay.
The new themed Port inspired by the Polygon will ensure that you soak in the event's atmosphere before you enter battle.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42c0f118-1438-11eb-98de-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42842eea-1438-11eb-add3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42a3db5a-1438-11eb-b9cb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42c37532-1438-11eb-a54c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
More details on the Key Battle rules, as well as the available rewards in the Armory, will come in a dedicated article.
Clan Missions
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5e282934-153d-11eb-93a5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Some missions related to Clan development have been added to the Clans section of the menu. Oil is the main reward given for completing these missions, but two of them will deliver Coal to the Clan Treasury. In total, you can earn up to 32,100 Oil and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png11,000 Coal. You can also earn the "Formidable Fleet" achievement.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/66fbb18e-1754-11eb-aa7c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The missions reward Clans for growing in size, participating in the Naval Battle, active playing of the Clan members, and fighting in Clan Battles. More details about the missions are available in the game client.

Aircraft Carrier Interface
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5e6555ac-153d-11eb-bb7f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

We've made some changes that will ensure you receive useful information about the status of your ship while controlling a squadron in the air.
A new marker pointing at your aircraft carrier has been added. It changes to indicate your ship's status: risk of collision, ship detected by the enemy, approaching torpedoes, etc.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/14d5aae4-175a-11eb-aa7c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Sound notifications have been updated. The least informative ones have been removed in order to make space for new notifications that relate to the aircraft carrier's status.
We've added the possibility to skip the attack animation and proceed directly to operating a squadron. The aircraft invulnerability period will be reduced by the duration of the skipped part of the animation.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a841f726-1541-11eb-bfeb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Armory
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5e10a750-153d-11eb-964f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

The new Samurai permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.pngX Shikishima has been added and made available in exchange for three Ranked Tokens.

The opportunity to exchange 12,500 Research Points for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png250,000 Free XP in the Research Bureau didn't prove to be popular, so it will be removed.

U.S. Battleships: Part 2
Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the live server. The new U.S. battleships will not be available to research on the Public Test server.
The event in Update 0.9.10 comprises combat missions, Daily Shipments, and a new collection dedicated to the U.S. Navy. It will inform you about the main batteries of battleships, admirals, medals for service in World Wars, and the main uniform types of enlisted men of the U.S. Navy during World War II.
For the purpose of standardization, the Directives have been renamed into combat mission groups.
"Always Courageous!" containers can be obtained by completing combat mission groups in the "U.S. Battleships 2" section and opening Daily Shipments. Each container holds one element of the new collection, as well as other rewards.
The "Always Courageous!" collection consists of four sections, with four elements in each.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c5726504-07b5-11eb-b859-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The rewards for completing each section are five expendable Stars'n'Stripes camouflages and such patches as Wings, Stars, and Stars'n'Stripes.
Completing the entire collection will bring you https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngV Oklahoma in the Military camouflage and a Commander with 6 skill points.
https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngV Oklahoma won't be available on the Public Test server.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dca68378-07be-11eb-9ce8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Elements of the collection can only be obtained from event-related containers.

We've also updated the Naval Base Port.

[table][tr][td]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f96b6406-07be-11eb-9ce8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/td]
[td]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f963bd6e-07be-11eb-aa4e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/td][/tr][/table]
When Update 0.9.11 goes live, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Kansas, https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Minnesota, and https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngX Vermont will leave Early Access and become available for all players to research.
Big Hunt: The Key to Victory!
A new temporary battle type—Key Battles—has been added to celebrate Halloween. A new themed Port emphasizes the event's atmosphere. Demonstrate your skills in an exhibition competition of the future by assuming command over a ship representing one of three corporations!
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d4f924d0-07b6-11eb-ac3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d4f0a468-07b6-11eb-bc8c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d521023e-07b6-11eb-af87-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on a gigantic Polygon map. The main objective is to exit the Polygon through a portal located at the center of the map. In order to do so, you need to destroy one of the special monsters and obtain a key. The monsters will initially be quite weak, but they will become more dangerous as you get closer to the portal.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a414e170-07bf-11eb-9ce8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Instead of the usual rectangular Minimap, the new battle type features a round one with the player's ship at its center. It shows everything within the spotting range of your ship.

You start out alone, but you can gather a team of up to three ships directly in battle. Only one player can use the key, which is why you'll face a choice—go all the way with your allies, or turn your guns against them and escape as a lone wolf via the portal. To invite a player to your team, aim at them and press F.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f9052ed8-07bf-11eb-9ed6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f8fdf726-07bf-11eb-9ce8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f9117846-07bf-11eb-8c94-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The number of keys is limited. After the last key has been used, the remaining ships will be transported to a special area—the Octagon. The final battle takes place in a gradually shrinking combat zone. The last surviving ship will also leave the Polygon successfully.

For destroying monsters and other players, you'll get a temporary resource—Battle Points. Having accumulated a certain number of Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle. For example, you can reduce incoming damage or increase the damage dealt by your guns. Once you earn a certain number of Points, a window will appear. This will allow you to select one of the two improvements. Use Ctrl+1 and Ctrl+2 to select. You don't need to spend any Points to make your selection.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b8a1405c-07bf-11eb-8c94-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Any Points you earn can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory. Successfully escaping the Polygon will bring you additional Battle Points. Please note: exiting through the portal will get you more Points than winning in the Octagon.
The rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the live server.
A total of three ships are available for this battle type in Update 0.9.10. Each of them offers a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on gameplay. For example, you could replace standard torpedoes with a type that temporarily disables all the main armaments of an enemy, but deal less damage. The choice of weapons is not limited to simple guns—lasers, plasma torpedoes, wavecasters, and mortars are all at your disposal. For example, wavecasters can destroy torpedoes in the water, while plasma ammunition heats up the target's armor and temporarily increases the damage dealt by subsequent hits of plasma shells and torpedoes to the same area. New modules are unlocked by completing special combat missions.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cc8b61ba-07bf-11eb-bf05-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The first ship will be available immediately, while the second and the third are obtained by completing a chain of combat missions.

Clan Battles: "Northern Waters" Season
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3b61cd1e-018e-11eb-8c61-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts:  Wed. 07 Oct. 13:30 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends:  Mon. 23 Nov. 06:30 CEST (UTC+2)

Format: 7 vs. 7 playing Tier X ships
Restrictions: up to two battleships, or one battleship and one aircraft carrier per team
Rewards: up to 11,000 Steel and many other rewards
Maps: Islands of Ice, Sleeping Giant, Warrior's Path, North, Greece, and Northern Waters, in Domination mode
Season features: in the new Season, all maps may feature a cyclone
The cyclone settles over the sea at the very start of a battle. Players should choose the most appropriate tactics in response to the conditions.
Cyclones reduce the viewing radius of aircraft to 8 km.
At the fourth minute of a battle, the viewing radius of ships starts to shrink, too. After 30 seconds, it gets reduced to 14 km.
After 15 and a half minutes of battle, the cyclone will start to fade away. Its effects will vanish completely after a further 30 seconds.

Essentially, the cyclone is designed to reduce the reconnaissance potential of aircraft carriers in Clan Battles. The option to add a maximum of two battleships or replace one of them with one carrier will make team lineups and battle tactics in the upcoming Season more diverse. For example, it's possible that destroyers might prove to be a popular choice.

Full details of the Season will be released in a dedicated article.

Mercenaries
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3b7b1e86-018e-11eb-ac2b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Division Commanders now have the option to invite "mercenaries," i.e. players from outside their Clan or from other Clans, to join their Divisions for Clan Battles.

The new feature will allow Clan leaders to test candidates who want to join their Clans in real combat scenarios, or fill roster gaps without having to actually accept new players into the Clan.

Rules
To add a mercenary to the team, simply invite them to join your Division. You can search for players via the "Divisions" tab in the game client.
After a battle, the mercenary receives rewards based on the current league of the Clan they went into battle with.
The mercenary may also receive achievements and emblems for Clan Battles, based on the current league of the Clan they went into battle with.
However, the mercenary will not receive the associated economic bonuses of the Clan they fought for.
A mercenary from a different Clan will be able to enter battle during the Prime Time of the inviting Clan. The selected Prime Time of the Clan that the mercenary belongs to will not change.

During the "Northern Waters" Season of Clan Battles, only one mercenary can be invited to a Division.

Research Bureau
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ba7676f4-018e-11eb-9fe4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
We've added a victory bonus of 200 Research Points for Tier V ships.
The following achievements have been added: Junior Shipbuilder, Senior Shipbuilder, Shipbuilding Inspector, and Chief Shipbuilding Inspector. The achievements will be issued for 10/50/100/150 ship branches that you have reset.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0a83b098-0226-11eb-8394-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Only ship branches that you reset after Update 0.9.9 goes live will count towards your progress for the new achievements and the bonus for Tier V ships.

More details about the Research Bureau will appear in a dedicated article.

Changes to Game Mechanics
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/babd2144-018e-11eb-b66a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

We've updated the mechanics behind the interactions between shells and main battery barbettes / turrets.

Previously, when a shell hit the main battery turret, damage was dealt only to the module itself, and the player received a "Penetration" ribbon without any actual damage having been dealt to the enemy ship. Now, hitting the main battery turret also entails a reduction in the ship's hit points.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/750165da-022d-11eb-b625-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The change will significantly reduce the number of no-damage penetrations.
Any damage dealt to a main battery turret also entails damage to the ship in the amount of 1/10 of the maximum damage of the shell.
The amount of damage dealt to the main battery turret modules in case of a penetration has been reduced 3.3 times.
The number of hit points for main battery turret modules has been reduced by half.
Damage affecting a ship's HP from a shell hitting any of the ship's main battery turrets can be restored completely using the Repair Party and Specialized Repair Teams consumables.
The barbette models have been updated.

Visual Improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ba9b062c-018e-11eb-b0e3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
We've improved the sea rendering quality for all graphics settings. Sun glare on the water's surface now looks more realistic; the horizon is now rendered at a higher quality; and water will now appear in a range of different shades, depending on the map. This change will improve game client performance. The changes will be most visible at low and medium graphics quality settings.
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a0ee9f8c-022d-11eb-a627-8cdcd4b147d4.gif
The Spaceport has been updated to accommodate the new lighting model and enhanced HDR technology.
We've changed the visual appearance of the aiming reticles for carrier squadrons, and also reworked the aircraft camera performance. This change will affect only the visual component of a squadron's interface, making it easier to aim with all types of armament without affecting gameplay.
Aircraft aiming reticles will no longer adjust to changes in the terrain of islands. A special indicator will notify you that your armament is about to hit terrain, and the reticle will become slightly more transparent. The new feature will also help prevent scenarios when a player is fully aimed at a target ship, but there are still terrain obstacles in the path of the payload release trajectory.
Aircraft operating as part of a squadron will now change positions in a smoother way; the trajectory of bombers moving in on a target will change slightly, and any damage taken by the aircraft in the process will cause it to shake.
The visibility of aircraft aiming reticles on sunlight-reflecting water has been improved.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/aabb953c-0224-11eb-bc28-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b51b82a-0224-11eb-bebc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/aabeff7e-0224-11eb-8394-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Technical Changes and Improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ba704cfc-018e-11eb-981a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

With the release of Update 0.9.9, players will be able to play on all World of Warships servers within a single game client, without the need to install separate game instances for each region. The game server will be determined by the currently selected account in the Wargaming Game Center.

We recommend that you delete all additional game instances installed on your computer before the release of Update 0.9.9. Please note: you will still need a separate game client for Public Tests.

We've seen drops in game client performance and aiming reticle distortions on devices with graphics cards that don't support DirectX 11 features. For this reason, we are discontinuing support for graphics cards that don't meet the minimum system requirements.

List of unsupported graphics cards
NVIDIA: all graphics cards older than the GeForce 400 series.
AMD: all graphics cards older than the Radeon HD 5000 Series.
Intel: all graphics cards older than Intel HD 3000.

Support for the macOS operating system will cease with the release of Update 0.10.0. We made this decision due to the low popularity of this OS among our players. Supporting macOS restrains our ability to improve the visuals of the game and its overall performance.

More details are available in this article.

Content additions and changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/109724a2-018f-11eb-b791-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Armory
The following ships will become available in the Armory with the release of the Update:
https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.pngX Franklin D. Roosevelt—available in exchange for 33,000 Steel. A Midway-class aircraft carrier that can boast of having solid armor protection. The extensive HP pools of her aircraft and large squadron size allow her to carry out continuous powerful attacks, even when her aircraft, which lack the Repair consumable, fall under heavy AA enemy fire.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fe882794-0228-11eb-b23f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX Paolo Emilio—available in exchange for 43,000 Research Points. This destroyer was initially designed as light cruiser intended for use in reconnaissance operations of the Italian Navy. She's fast, and equipped with good artillery that's capable of firing SAP and HE shells, all at the cost of a long reload time. The ship's powerful torpedo armament, coupled with access to the Emergency Engine Power and Exhaust Smoke Generator consumables, make her ideal for lightning-fast attacks at short ranges.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fe186968-0228-11eb-868d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Other changes
We're continuing our work on enhancing the Daily Shipments: two new options will be added in Update 0.9.9. We'll test the new mechanics as the Update goes live. To ensure that we get credible test results, some players will collect their rewards via the "old" version of Daily Shipments, while others will receive the new ones. This research will also require a random reference group, which is why certain players will unfortunately not have access to Daily Shipments during this Update.

A "Gothic" permanent camouflage for https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Bismarck has been added to the game. Details on how to get it will follow a bit later.

https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Mainz has been added to the Tech Tree, and will be available for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png11,000 doubloons.

https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVIII Tirpitz has temporarily been removed from the Tech Tree. However, she will still be available via the Armory.

The following ships have been added for testing by developers, supertesters, and community contributors: https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX Hizen, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.pngIX Z-44, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngVII Strasbourg, https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.pngX Plymouth, and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVI Mysore.

Other Changes
Check under the spoiler for more information regarding balance-related changes, content changes and additions, and other improvements.

Improvements to the combat mission interface
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/104a8db8-018f-11eb-b0e3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
We've re-enabled the option to jump to the Combat Missions section by clicking on the icon of a combat mission that drops from a container.
A list of combat missions that you've scrolled down will now automatically scroll back up when switching between tabs.
A combat mission hint that pops up on the post-battle results screen will now show the progress you've made towards the conditions of that mission in a battle.
When navigating to the Directives tab, the currently active Directive will be selected by default.

Game balance changes
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1095c9ea-018f-11eb-8c61-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

In Update 0.9.9, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their combat efficiency and feedback from players. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

Tier V British cruiser Hawkins
Main battery reload time reduced from 12.6 to 12.1 s

Tier VIII U.K. aircraft carrier Implacable
Changes to HE bomb characteristics:
Maximum damage increased from 4,700 to 4,900
Chance to cause fire on a target increased from 27% to 28%

Tier X Soviet cruiser Petropavlovsk
Detectability range by sea increased from 14.9 to 15.4 km. Other detectability values have been increased accordingly

Tier IX Soviet cruiser Riga
Main battery reload time reduced from 15.0 to 14.5 s
Detectability range by sea increased from 14.74 to 15.04 km. Other detectability values were increased accordingly

Engine Boost Modification 1 upgrade
Bonus to the action time of the Engine Boost and Emergency Engine Power consumables reduced from +40% to +30%

Other changes and improvements
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/104f8f02-018f-11eb-ac2b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

Please note: running Overwolf application may cause World of Warships client collapse. To fix the issue, update Overwolf to the latest version. If the issue still persists, please contact the Customer Service Center.

Fixed a mistake in the description of Task 6 of Mission 4 in the "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign.
Fixed a bug in the autopilot voiceovers for the following Commanders: Kaguya, Chang'e, and Hou Yi.
The names of modules of attack aircraft now contain an HE or AP designation for their rockets.
Reduced the frequency of a situation that caused the game client to crash during authorization.
Reduced the frequency of a situation that caused a ship with autopilot enabled to leave her charted course.
Fixed an issue that caused the Expert Marksman skill to provide incorrect bonuses to the traverse speed of main battery guns.
Fixed an issue that caused the game client to crash after navigating to the Dockyard before the ship being built appeared.
Fixed an issue that, in certain cases, made it impossible to authorize in the game after minimizing the client window and then maximizing it again.
Other improvements and changes. For a complete list, please refer to Player Support.

Ends:  Tue. 15 Sep. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)

Special Features of the Test
The Public Test server will host Clan Battles, with Tier X ships facing each other in a 3 vs. 3 format.

Procedure
A maximum of two mercenaries per Division.
Ship restrictions per team:
A maximum of one destroyer, cruiser, and aircraft carrier.
A maximum two battleships. If the team has one aircraft carrier, there can be no more than one battleship in the same team.

Developer Bulletin 0.9.9
IMPORTANT! Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the Update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the Update is released.
[table][tr][th]U.S. Battleships: Part 1 ● Mercenaries ● Other Changes[/th][/tr][/table]
U.S. Battleships: Part 1
Update 0.9.9 kicks off an event with the new U.S. battleships https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Kansas and https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Minnesota right in spotlight! These ships will become available in Early Access on the Live Server only when the Update is released. Meanwhile, we invite you to take part in the testing of the event.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f7a80758-f19f-11ea-98b3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the live server. The new U.S. battleships will not be available on the Public Test server.
Features of the Ship Branch
Numerous main battery guns with a solid salvo weight and decent firing range, which comes at the expense of longer gun reload times.
The ships enjoy great maneuverability for their type, as well as good anti-torpedo protection, but are rather slow.
Their decent AA defenses are reinforced by the availability of the Defensive AA Fire consumable.
Early Access: https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngVIII Kansas can be obtained by completing Directives. https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.pngIX Minnesota can be obtained from random bundles that are available in the Armory in exchange for doubloons.

Rewards for completing Directives: a new temporary resource called American Tokens.

Rewards in exchange for American Tokens: sequentially available bundles with Gold Eagle permanent camouflage patterns for the new U.S. battleships, as well as other rewards.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f7ac1190-f19f-11ea-ab04-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The Naval Base Port has been updated.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7512124c-f1a0-11ea-9d49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Mercenaries
Division Commanders will now have the option to invite "mercenaries," i.e. players from outside their Clan, to join their Divisions for Clan Battles.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c937e80a-f1a1-11ea-a814-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The new feature will allow Clan leaders to test candidates who want to join their Clan in a real combat scenario, or fill any roster gaps without having to actually accept new players into the Clan.

The following rules apply to mercenaries:
To add a mercenary to the team, simply invite them to join your Division. You can search for players via the "Divisions" tab in the game client.
After a battle, the mercenary receives rewards based on the league of the Clan they went into battle with.
However, the mercenary will not receive the associated economic bonuses of the Clan they fought for.
Other Changes
The barbettes and main battery guns have been updated for all ships. Previously, when a shell hit the main battery turret, damage was dealt only to the module itself, and the player received a "Penetration" ribbon without any actual damage having been dealt to the enemy ship. Now, any damage dealt to the main battery turret also entails a reduction in the ship's hit points in the amount of 1/10 of the maximum damage of the shell. This way, hitting a turret will no longer result in a penetration without inflicting actual damage.

We've changed the visual appearance of aiming reticles for carrier squadrons and reworked the aircraft camera performance. This change will affect only the visual component of a squadron's interface, making it easier to aim with all types of armament without affecting gameplay.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7733cca8-f1a2-11ea-a814-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7733e9c2-f1a2-11ea-8800-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/76e46c26-f1a2-11ea-bf3f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Any aircraft operating within a squadron will now change position in a smoother way; the trajectory of bombers moving in on a target will change slightly, and any damage taken by the aircraft in the process will cause it to shake.

We've improved the visual display of water for all graphic settings. In particular, the visual noise applied to the sea has been removed entirely on the horizon. This change will improve game client performance.

The Spaceport has been updated to accommodate the new lighting model and enhanced HDR technology.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4fb8715a-f1a3-11ea-af28-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

World of Warships Anniversary
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7514a99a-eb82-11ea-831e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg

With Update 0.9.8, World of Warships is celebrating its Fifth Anniversary! The festive Update offers a bunch of gifts and in-game activities: a permanent Campaign titled "Five Epochs of the Navy," plus a collection of the same name; fresh first-win bonuses, a revamped Designer's Table Port, and a new battle type—Asymmetric Battles.

Permanent "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2e1ac68-e93f-11ea-99bf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign comprises 50 tasks grouped into five missions, each of which is dedicated to a specific shipbuilding epoch. To finish the Campaign, you'll need to complete tasks playing ships of various tiers: starting from Tier II–IV ships for the first mission, and progressing to Tiers VIII–X for the final mission.
Reward for finishing the Campaign: Epoch permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2846792783415563078

"Five Epochs of the Navy" Collection
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55568bba-e93d-11ea-a5d3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection is made up of five sections, with six elements in each. Each section is dedicated to a specific period in the history of shipbuilding.

Only "Five Epochs of the Navy" containers drop collectibles.
The reward for completing the entire collection: Epoch permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2cd7342-e93f-11ea-adbc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg
The Epoch permanent camouflage can be mounted on any Tier IX ship, except for https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.pngIX AL Sov. Rossiya. Once mounted on a ship, the camouflage remains assigned to that ship. Another copy of the camouflage can be assigned to a different ship.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2846792783415563078

Victory Bonuses
During Update 0.9.8, you can expect a festive bonus for your first victories of the Update with certain ships. It can be secured on ships starting from Tier V:
Tiers V–VII: 2x World of Warships Anniversary camouflage patterns
Tier VIII: 1x Gift container
Tier IX: 2x Gift containers
Tier X: 1x supercontainer
Asymmetric Battles
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/754588f8-eb82-11ea-8e7d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png Starts:   Thu. 03 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)
Ends: Thu. 17 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)

In an Asymmetric Battle, a team of five to seven Tier VII–VIII ships will confront a team of nine to twelve ships of Tiers V–VI.
To enter battle with Tier VII–VIII ships, you'll need to spend a new temporary resource—Battle Tokens. The cost of entering a battle playing Tier VII–VIII ships is 500 Battle Tokens.
Battle Tokens can be earned in Asymmetric Battles:
Tier V: 250 Tokens per battle
Tier VI: 150 Tokens per battle
Tier VII: 200 Tokens per battle
Tier VIII: 25 Tokens per battle
You'll receive 1,000 Tokens each day upon logging in to the game.
Tokens are earned irrespective of the battle results, but players will not be awarded them if they are inactive.

Please note: Battle Tokens are only used to participate in Asymmetric Battles. With the release of Update 0.9.9 all Battle Tokens will be converted into credits at a rate of 1:50. Asymmetric Battles become available after reaching Access Level 12.

Developer Bulletin 0.9.8
The World of Warships Anniversary, new Dockyard, Season 18 of Ranked Battles, and other features!
IMPORTANT! Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. [table][tr][th]World of Warships Anniversary ● Ranked Battles ● Other Changes[/th][/tr][/table]
World of Warships Anniversary
With the release of Update 0.9.8, World of Warships passes the threshold of its fifth year!

This time, the festive frenzy is inspired by naval history. The game will feature plenty of new and engaging content to mark the occasion, including a revamped Designer's Table Port, a permanent campaign titled "Five Epochs of the Navy" plus a collection of the same name, a new Dockyard, and fresh first-win bonuses. You can also try out a new battle type—Asymmetric Battle!

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/46204f10-dbdb-11ea-9ae3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The collection and new permanent campaign are both dedicated to the history of shipbuilding.

The Five Epochs of the Navy permanent campaign features 50 tasks spread across 5 missions.

Reward for completing the campaign: an Epoch permanent camouflage, which can be applied to the majority of Tier IX ships.
The Five Epochs of the Navy collection is made up of five sections, with six elements in each. Each section is dedicated to a specific era in the history of shipbuilding. Elements of the collection can only be obtained from the same-name containers. The exchange rate of duplicates for missing elements is 1:1.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09d523c8-dbd6-11ea-bf4b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Five Epochs of the Navy containers will be available during the campaign of the same name. Each container will drop an element from the Five Epochs of the Navy collection, as well as other rewards.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a6118892-dbd8-11ea-a905-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Reward for completing the collection: an Epoch permanent camouflage, which can be applied to the majority of Tier IX ships.
https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d4138024-dbd8-11ea-a905-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Asymmetric Battle
https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1e357130-dbd9-11ea-a5ba-8cdcd4b147d4.pngDuring the first two festive weeks of the World of Warships Fifth Anniversary, you can try out a new temporary battle type—Asymmetric Battle—with a differing distribution of ships and tiers between teams.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/41dc5988-dbd8-11ea-b2c5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Historically, encounters at sea have typically involved opposing sides with an unequal number of ships on each side. The new battle type offers a new gameplay experience in near-real naval combat conditions.

In an Asymmetric Battle, a team of four to six Tier VII–VIII ships will confront a team of eight to twelve ships of Tiers V–VI. Helming Tier VII–VIII ships in an Asymmetric Battle will require a new temporary resource called Battle Tokens.

Battle Tokens can be obtained by participating in Asymmetric Battles. The number of Tokens you get from each battle depends on the tier of ship you helm—the lower the tier, the more Tokens you can get.

This way, you'll be able to participate in an Asymmetric Battle with lower and higher-tier ships for a more immersive experience in the new battle type.

Dockyard
In Update 0.9.8, players will be able to build a new U.S. Tier VIII cruiser—https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.pnghttps://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.pngVIII Anchorage. The rules of the new Dockyard are in many ways similar to those applied to the Hamburg Dockyard, but the list of rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases has changed. For example, completing phase 12 will bring you {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png100,000 Free XP.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4172ed90-dbd8-11ea-bf4b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

The construction process of the Dockyard comprises 20 phases.
Each shipbuilding phase can be completed by finishing the Directives of the event, or by spending {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png1,750 doubloons per phase.
Event Directives will span two updates—0.9.8 and 0.9.9, and the Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the end of Update 0.9.10.
In total, you can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases by finishing Directives.
Anchorage and her National camouflage, along with a 10-skill Commander, Port slot, and commemorative flag, await you upon completing the 20th phase.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/46384e12-dbdb-11ea-9d9a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

If you decide to complete shipbuilding at the Dockyard by using doubloons, you can still progress through the Directives. However, in that case, instead of the usual rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases, you'll get 600 Research Points for each completed phase. If you have not yet opened the Research Bureau, you'll get access to it immediately with the first Research Points you earn.

Victory Bonuses
In Update 0.9.8, players will be able to receive a festive bonus for their first victory in the Update, secured on every ship starting from Tier V.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/461007d6-dbdb-11ea-8ee6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

List of Rewards
Tiers V–VII: 2x World of Warships Anniversary camouflages
Tier VIII: 1x Gift container
Tier IX: 2x Gift containers
Tier X: 1x supercontainer
Gift Container
A Gift container holds five special signals of one type (Dragon, Red Dragon, Wyvern, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan).

Ranked Battles
Update 0.9.8 kicks off a new Season of Ranked Battles. You can expect to play Tier X ships in an 8 vs. 8 format.

Other Changes
The visual display of fog in the game has been enhanced by adopting an updated spacial distribution system and adding a scattered sunlight effect. Apart from improving the visual component, this change will also provide a slight improvement in the game client's performance.

https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8690630-dbd6-11ea-bb82-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg

Naval Legends audio recordings have been added to the pool of in-battle soundtrack options.

Setting the Order of Consumables
